t1278101.movie_title_jp: ちっぽけな僕の、おおきな世界
t1278101.clean_title_jp: ちっぽけな僕の、おおきな世界
t1278101.synopsis: 「少年の君」のジャクソン・イーが主演を務め、脳性まひの青年が自らの意思で人生を切りひらいていく姿を、家族それぞれが抱える痛みとともに描いたヒューマンドラマ。 脳性まひを抱える20歳のリウ・チュンホーは、身体の障害や周囲の偏見、母親の身勝手な愛情に向き合いながら、自分らしい人生を模索している。祖母のスーチュンだけは「障害のある孫」ではなくひとりの青年としてチュンホーに接し、社会へ踏み出す勇気を与え続けてきた。やがて、若い女性ヤーヤとの出会いや新たな経験を通して、チュンホーの心に少しずつ変化が起こりはじめる。 ジャクソン・イーが主人公チュンホーを熱演し、中国電影金鶏賞および大衆電影百花賞で最優秀主演男優賞を獲得。破天荒な祖母スーチュンを「フェアウェル」のダイアナ・リンが演じた。「春夢」「老人」「春潮」などで高く評価されたヤン・リーナーが監督を務め、脚本を「シスター　夏のわかれ道」のヨウ・シャオイン、音楽を小林武史が担当。2024年・第37回東京国際映画祭コンペティション部門にて観客賞を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「小さな私」）。
t1278101.synopsis_en: A human drama starring Jackson Yee of 'Better Days,' depicting a young man with cerebral palsy carving out his own life by his own will, along with the pain each family member carries. Liu Chunhe, a 20-year-old with cerebral palsy, searches for a life true to himself while confronting his physical disability, the prejudices of those around him, and his mother's selfish love. Only his grandmother Shuichun treats Chunhe not as a 'grandson with a disability' but as a young man, continually giving him the courage to step out into society. Eventually, through encounters with a young woman named Yaya and new experiences, a change begins to stir little by little in Chunhe's heart. Jackson Yee passionately plays the protagonist Chunhe, winning Best Actor at the China Golden Rooster Awards and the Hundred Flowers Awards. Diana Lin of 'The Farewell' plays the unconventional grandmother Shuichun. Yang Lina, highly acclaimed for 'Spring Dream,' 'Old Man,' and 'Spring Tide,' directs, with the screenplay by Xiao Ying of 'Sister' and music by Takeshi Kobayashi. It won the Audience Award in the Competition section at the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2024 (titled 'Small Me' at the time of the festival screening).
t1278101.tmdb_overview_en: Liu Chunhe, suffering from cerebral palsy, bravely breaks through the shackles of body and mind to realize the dream stage for his grandmother, while trying to find the coordinates of his own life. After experiencing a summer transformation, he finally embarked on a new journey.
t1278101.tmdb_overview_jp: フィクションとドキュメンタリー双方で活躍するヤン・リーナーの監督作品。障がいを持ちながらも力強く生きる若者を、その母、祖母との関係のなかに描く。『少年の君』（19）でスターとなったイー・ヤンチェンシーが主演。

t106378.synopsis: 「横道世之介」「さかなのこ」の沖田修一が、2009年に商業映画デビュー作として手がけたヒューマンドラマ。南極観測隊で料理を担当していた西村淳のエッセイ「面白南極料理人」を原作に、南極観測隊の料理人と、その料理を心の支えに暮らす隊員たちの日々を、ユーモアと温かなまなざしで描く。 南極観測隊の料理人として、ドームふじ基地へやって来た西村淳。極限の環境で暮らす隊員たちにとって、日々の食事は何よりの楽しみだ。ラーメンやおにぎり、伊勢エビフライにローストビーフ。手間ひまかけた料理で仲間たちの顔がほころぶ瞬間が、西村にとって一番の喜びだった。しかし日本には、妻と8歳の娘、生まれたばかりの息子が待っている。1万4000キロ彼方の家族を思いながら、約1年半に及ぶ越冬生活が始まる。 料理人・西村を演じるのは堺雅人。生瀬勝久、きたろう、高良健吾、豊原功補ら個性豊かな面々が観測隊員を演じる。音楽を「ユニコーン」のABEDON（阿部義晴）、主題歌に同バンドの「サラウンド」を起用した。2026年、東京テアトル創立80周年を記念したファン投票で1位に選ばれたことを受け、4Kリマスター版としてリバイバル公開される。
t106378.synopsis_en: A human drama directed by Shuichi Okita, known for "Yokomichi Yonosuke" and "The Fish Tale," as his 2009 commercial film debut. Based on Jun Nishimura's essay "Omoshiro Nankyoku Ryorinin" (The Interesting Antarctic Chef), it depicts with humor and a warm gaze the days of the cook for an Antarctic research expedition and the team members who rely on his cooking as a source of emotional support. Jun Nishimura arrives at Dome Fuji Station as the cook for the Antarctic research expedition. For the team members living in an extreme environment, daily meals are the greatest pleasure. Ramen, rice balls, fried lobster, roast beef—the moments when his comrades' faces light up over dishes made with time and effort are Nishimura's greatest joy. But back in Japan, his wife, his eight-year-old daughter, and his newborn son are waiting. Thinking of his family 14,000 kilometers away, his overwintering life of about a year and a half begins. Masato Sakai plays the cook Nishimura. A colorful ensemble including Katsuhisa Namase, Kitaro, Kengo Kora, and Kosuke Toyohara play the expedition members. Music is by ABEDON (Yoshiharu Abe) of Unicorn, with the band's song "Surround" used as the theme song. In 2026, following its selection as No. 1 in a fan vote commemorating the 80th anniversary of Tokyo Theatres' founding, it will be re-released as a 4K remaster.
t106378.tmdb_overview_en: When eight men are assigned to live 14,000 kilometers from home in inhumanly cold conditions, food becomes their new existence.
t106378.tmdb_overview_jp: 西村は南極の昭和基地からも遠く離れた陸の孤島、南極ドームふじ基地に料理人として派遣される。妻と娘を置いての単身赴任生活で、彼は8人の男性南極越冬隊員たちの胃袋を満たすという大役を任される。基地では雪氷学者をはじめ、雪氷サポート隊員らが彼の料理を心待ちにしており……。

t1748514.synopsis: 森田剛が主演を務め、マンガの制作現場を舞台に万年アシスタントの中年男性の奮闘を軽やかにつづったヒューマンドラマ。 巨匠マンガ家のアシスタントを長年にわたり務めてきた、42歳の土屋輝一。マンガ家デビューした後輩や人気声優である別居中の妻に対してモヤモヤした思いを抱え、一緒に暮らす高校受験生の娘とも気持ちがすれ違ってばかりいる。そんな彼のもとに、あるマンガ企画が舞い込む。仕事への熱量不足を自覚する29歳の中堅編集者・潮田ユキと、マンガ家を志す猪突猛進な40歳の新人アシスタント・山田ぽてとと共に、マンガ制作に踏み出す土屋だったが……。 編集者・潮田ユキ役で森川葵、新人アシスタント・山田ぽてと役で川上友里、潮田の上司である編集部長・馬場明役で阿部寛、土屋の別居中の妻・莉花役で松本まりか、土屋がアシスタントを務める巨匠マンガ家・吉住はるを役で武田鉄矢、土屋の娘・ひかり役で早瀬憩が共演。監督は、是枝裕和監督作の助監督などを務めてきた森本晶一と、「泣く子はいねぇが」の佐藤快磨。是枝監督率いる映像制作者集団「分福」に所属する両監督が共同監督を務め、森本監督が自身の経験に着想を得て原案・オリジナル脚本を手がけた。
t1748514.synopsis_en: A human drama starring Go Morita that lightly depicts the struggles of a middle-aged man who has been a perpetual assistant in the manga production industry. Koichi Tsuchiya, 42, has spent years as an assistant to a master manga artist. He harbors complicated feelings toward a junior colleague who made his manga debut before him and toward his estranged wife, a popular voice actress, and his feelings constantly miss the mark with his high school exam-taking daughter who lives with him. Then a certain manga project lands in his lap. Alongside Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old mid-level editor aware of her own lack of passion for the work, and Yamada Potato, a headstrong 40-year-old new assistant who dreams of becoming a manga artist, Tsuchiya sets out on manga production—but... Aoi Morikawa plays editor Yuki Shioda, Yuri Kawakami plays new assistant Yamada Potato, Hiroshi Abe plays Shioda's boss and editorial department head Akira Baba, Marika Matsumoto plays Tsuchiya's estranged wife Rika, Tetsuya Takeda plays the master manga artist Haruo Yoshizumi whom Tsuchiya assists, and Ikoi Hayase plays Tsuchiya's daughter Hikari. The directors are Shoichi Morimoto, who has served as assistant director on Hirokazu Kore-eda's films, and Kaishu Sato of "The Kids Are Fine." Both directors belong to the filmmaking collective "Bunbuku" led by Kore-eda, and serve as co-directors; Morimoto conceived the original story and wrote the original screenplay inspired by his own experiences.
t1748514.tmdb_overview_en: Teruichi Tsuchiya, 42, is a perpetual assistant to a master manga artist. He feels uneasy about his junior colleague who has debuted as a manga artist, his estranged wife who is a popular voice actress, and for some reason, he is constantly at odds with his daughter, who lives with him and is preparing for her high school entrance exams. Just as a 17-year-old manga series comes to an end, a new manga project comes along. Joining him are Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old editor who is aware of his lack of passion for his work, and Potato Yamada, a headstrong 40-year-old rookie assistant. What future awaits him after taking this step…?

t1773014.movie_title: 4アウト　もう一度、プレイボール
t1773014.movie_title_jp: 4アウト　もう一度、プレイボール
t1773014.clean_title_jp: 4アウト ─もう一度、プレイボール─
t1773014.movie_title_original: 4アウト ─もう一度、プレイボール─
t1773014.synopsis: 作家・平山讓のノンフィクション小説「4アウト　ある障害者野球チームの挑戦」を原作に、東京に初めて結成された身体障害者野球チーム「東京ブルーサンダース」の創設にまつわる実話を映画化。 子どもの頃から野球一筋だった矢上雄一は、結婚して父になってからも社会人野球に情熱を注いでいたが、年齢の壁には勝てず戦力外通告を受けてしまう。身体障害者スポーツセンターに再就職した彼は、聴覚障害を持つ泉邦衛から野球チームの監督を依頼され、戸惑いながらも引き受けることを決める。同僚の高橋明日香と共に選手集めに奔走し、やがてチームは全国大会に挑むことになるが、現実は厳しく初めての大舞台で惨敗してしまう。「勝ちたい」と言いながらも悔しそうな様子を見せない選手たちに失望した矢上は、監督を降りると宣言するが……。 相葉雅紀が矢上雄一役で主演を務め、実際の身体障害者野球チームとの交流や練習を重ねて撮影に臨んだ。矢上の同僚でチームマネージャーの高橋明日香役で黒島結菜、聴覚障害を持つ泉邦衛役で松本利夫、矢上の妻・道子役で前田亜季、障害者スポーツセンター所長・阿武隈薫役で斉藤由貴、NPO法人日本身体障害者野球連盟を創設した初代理事長をモデルとした岩橋広司役で佐々木蔵之介が共演。さらに、約200人の障がい者オーディションで選ばれたキャストが多数出演した。監督は、緒方明監督や廣木隆一監督のもとで助監督として経験を積み、本作で長編映画監督デビューを果たした稲垣壮洋。
t1773014.synopsis_en: Based on the nonfiction book '4 Out: The Challenge of a Disabled Baseball Team' by author Jo Hiryama, this film dramatizes the true story behind the founding of the Tokyo Blue Thunders, the first baseball team for people with physical disabilities formed in Tokyo. Yuichi Yagami, who devoted himself to baseball since childhood, continued to pour his passion into corporate baseball even after marrying and becoming a father, but unable to overcome the wall of age, he is told he is no longer part of the team's plans. Reemployed at a sports center for people with disabilities, he is asked by Kuniei Izumi, who has a hearing disability, to manage a baseball team, and though bewildered, he decides to accept. Together with his colleague Asuka Takahashi, he rushes around recruiting players, and the team eventually takes on the national tournament, but reality is harsh and they suffer a crushing defeat on their first big stage. Disappointed by the players who say they 'want to win' yet show no frustrated expressions, Yagami declares he will step down as manager, but... Masaki Aiba stars as Yuichi Yagami, preparing for the role through exchanges and practice with an actual disabled baseball team. Yui Aragaki plays his colleague and team manager Asuka Takahashi, Toshio Matsumoto plays the hearing-impaired Kuniei Izumi, Aki Maeda plays Yagami's wife Michiko, Yuki Saito plays sports center director Kaoru Abukuma, and Kuranosuke Sasaki plays Hiroshi Iwahashi, modeled on the founding first chairman of the NPO Japan Physically Disabled Baseball Federation. In addition, many cast members selected through an audition of about 200 people with disabilities appear. The director is Takehiro Inagaki, who gained experience as an assistant director under directors Akira Ogata and Ryuichi Hiroki and makes his feature film directorial debut with this work.
t1773014.tmdb_overview_en: Masaki Aiba plays the lead role of Yagami. After being released from a corporate baseball team and feeling despondent, Yagami finds a new job at a sports center for people with disabilities. There, he takes on the role of manager for a baseball team consisting of just five players with disabilities… At first, Yagami was skeptical, wondering, "Can people with disabilities really play baseball?" But as he works up a sweat alongside the players and grows into a true manager, his journey is sure to touch the hearts of many.
t1773014.tmdb_overview_jp: 子どもの頃から野球一筋だった矢上雄一は、結婚して父になってからも社会人野球に情熱を注いでいたが、年齢の壁には勝てず戦力外通告を受けてしまう。身体障害者スポーツセンターに再就職した彼は、聴覚障害を持つ泉邦衛から野球チームの監督を依頼され、戸惑いながらも引き受けることを決める。同僚の高橋明日香と共に選手集めに奔走し、やがてチームは全国大会に挑むことになるが、現実は厳しく初めての大舞台で惨敗してしまう。「勝ちたい」と言いながらも悔しそうな様子を見せない選手たちに失望した矢上は、監督を降りると宣言するが……。

t1306816.movie_title: 世界で最後の愛しい娘！
t1306816.movie_title_jp: 世界で最後の愛しい娘！
t1306816.clean_title_jp: 世界で最後の愛しい娘！
t1306816.synopsis: 最愛の娘が世界で最後のゾンビになってしまった父親の奮闘を描いた、韓国発のハートフルコメディ。“ゾンビを生活に溶け込ませる”という斬新な設定で話題を呼んだウェブトゥーン「ゾンビ娘」を原作に、「人質　韓国トップスター誘拐事件」のピル・カムソン監督がメガホンをとった。 猛獣専門の飼育員として働くジョンファンは、ダンスに夢中な思春期の娘スアと父娘2人で賑やかな毎日を過ごしていた。しかしある日、謎のゾンビウイルスが韓国全土にまん延し、混乱のなかでスアも感染してしまう。祖母の住む海辺の村に身を寄せたジョンファンは、スアにまだ人間の心が残っていることに気づく。感染者たちが摘発されていくなか、ジョンファンは愛する娘を守るため、そして人間の心を取り戻させるため、長年の飼育員の経験を生かして前代未聞の極秘トレーニングを開始する。 「EXIT イグジット」のチョ・ジョンソクがジョンファン役で主演を務め、「パラサイト　半地下の家族」のイ・ジョンウンがジョンファンの母バムスン、同じく「パラサイト　半地下の家族」に出演したチョ・ヨジョンがジョンファンの初恋相手で中学校教師のヨンファ、「完璧な他人」のユン・ギョンホがジョンファンの親友ドンベ、「ザ・ソウルメイト」のチェ・ユリがジョンファンの愛娘スアを演じた。韓国では564万人を動員する大ヒットを記録し、2025年・第46回青龍映画賞で最多観客賞を受賞。
t1306816.synopsis_en: A heartwarming comedy from Korea about a father's struggles after his beloved daughter becomes the world's last zombie. Based on the webtoon "Zombie Daughter," which drew attention for its novel premise of "integrating zombies into daily life," the film is directed by Pil Gam-seong of "Hostage: Missing Celebrity." Jeong-hwan, who works as a zookeeper specializing in wild animals, spends lively days as a two-person household with his adolescent daughter Su-a, who is obsessed with dancing. But one day a mysterious zombie virus spreads across all of Korea, and amid the chaos Su-a becomes infected. Jeong-hwan takes refuge in the seaside village where his grandmother lives and realizes that Su-a still retains a human heart. As the infected are being rounded up, Jeong-hwan, to protect his beloved daughter and restore her human heart, draws on his years of zookeeper experience to begin unprecedented top-secret training. Jo Jung-suk of "Exit" stars as Jeong-hwan; Lee Jung-eun of "Parasite" plays Jeong-hwan's mother Bam-sun; Jo Yeo-jeong, also of "Parasite," plays Jeong-hwan's first love and middle-school teacher Yeong-hwa; Yoon Kyung-ho of "Perfect Strangers" plays Jeong-hwan's best friend Dong-bae; and Choi Yu-ri of "The Soulmate" plays Jeong-hwan's beloved daughter Su-a. The film was a huge hit in Korea, drawing 5.64 million admissions, and won the Most Popular Audience Award at the 46th Blue Dragon Film Awards in 2025.
t1306816.tmdb_overview_en: Jung-hwan is a gruff but loving zookeeper who specializes in training wild beasts. His teenage daughter, Soo-ah, is going through puberty and a full-blown dance obsession. Their days are full of bickering and bonding... until one day, Soo-ah becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. Refusing to give up on his daughter, Jung-hwan takes her to a quiet seaside village called Eunbong-ri, where his mother Bam-soon lives. In a world obsessed with rooting out the infected, Soo-ah shows strange signs of awareness - responding to music, her grandmother's sharp taps with a back scratcher, and even faint traces of human language. Determined to protect her at all costs, Jung-hwan draws on his years of experience training tigers and begins a secret mission to tame and retrain... his zombie daughter.

t1567149.movie_title: 仮面ライダーカブト 20th 天を継ぐもの
t1567149.movie_title_jp: 仮面ライダーカブト 20th 天を継ぐもの
t1567149.movie_title_en: Kamen Rider Kabuto 20th: ​​The One Who Inherits the Heavens
t1567149.clean_title_jp: 仮面ライダーカブト20th 天を継ぐもの
t1567149.movie_title_original: 仮面ライダーカブト20th 天を継ぐもの
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t1567149.synopsis: 2006年1月～2007年1月に放送された特撮テレビドラマ「仮面ライダーカブト」の20周年アニバーサリー作品として製作されたVシネマ作品で、テレビシリーズから20年後の世界を描いた続編。 人間に擬態して地球侵略を進める宇宙生命体ワームに対抗するため、秘密組織ZECTが開発した「マスクドライダーシステム」。ワームとZECT、そして仮面ライダーたちの戦いは、人類の勝利で終わったはずだった。戦いから20年が過ぎた現在。人類とワームは共存する道を歩んでいたが、ZECTは秘密裏に新たなマスクドライダーシステムを開発していた。その資格者として選ばれたのは、加賀美新の息子である高校生の結だった。結と接触を図ろうとしたZECTの三島正人の前に、結のクラスメイト・天道ヒカルが立ちはだかる。一方、田所修一から情報を得た加賀美新は、ZECTの陰謀に立ち向かうためかつての仲間たちの元を訪れるが、風間大介にも矢車想にも協力を拒否されてしまう。たったひとりで戦う覚悟を決めた加賀美の前に、意外な人物が姿を現す。 加賀美新／仮面ライダーガタック役の佐藤祐基、矢車想／仮面ライダーザビー役の徳山秀典、風間大介／仮面ライダードレイク役の加藤和樹、三島正人役の弓削智久、田所修一役の山口祥行、加賀美陸役の本田博太郎らオリジナルキャストが再集結するほか、加賀美新の息子・結役で荒木飛羽、結のクラスメイト・天道ヒカル役で小寺結花、テレビシリーズで風間大介と行動を共にしていた記憶喪失の少女・ゴン役で馬場ふみかが出演。
t1567149.synopsis_en: A V-cinema work produced as the 20th anniversary project of the tokusatsu TV drama Kamen Rider Kabuto, broadcast from January 2006 to January 2007, depicting a sequel set 20 years after the TV series. The Masked Rider System was developed by the secret organization ZECT to counter the Worms, space lifeforms that mimic humans and advance their invasion of Earth. The battle between the Worms, ZECT, and the Kamen Riders was supposed to have ended in humanity's victory. Now, 20 years after the battle, humans and Worms are walking a path of coexistence, but ZECT has secretly been developing a new Masked Rider System. Chosen as its qualifier is Yui, a high school student and the son of Arata Kagami. When ZECT's Masato Mishima tries to make contact with Yui, Yui's classmate Hikaru Tendou stands in his way. Meanwhile, Arata Kagami, having obtained information from Shuichi Tadokoro, visits his former comrades to oppose ZECT's conspiracy, but both Daisuke Kazama and Sou Yaguruma refuse to cooperate. Just as Kagami resolves to fight alone, an unexpected figure appears before him. Original cast members reunite, including Yuki Sato as Arata Kagami/Kamen Rider Gatack, Hidenori Tokuyama as Sou Yaguruma/Kamen Rider Zabee, Kazuki Kato as Daisuke Kazama/Kamen Rider Drake, Tomohisa Yuge as Masato Mishima, Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi as Shuichi Tadokoro, and Hirotaro Honda as Riku Kagami, joined by Towa Araki as Kagami's son Yui, Yuka Kotera as Yui's classmate Hikaru Tendou, and Fumika Baba as Gon, the amnesiac girl who accompanied Daisuke Kazama in the TV series.
t1567149.tmdb_overview_en: 20 years after the events of the series, humans and Worms are walking towards the path of coexistence. However, ZECT is secretly developing a new Masked Rider System. Yui Kagami, the son of Arata Kagami/Kamen Rider Gatack is qualified to use the new system. Arata Kagami also investigates a ZECT conspiracy all by himself, but a shadow of an unexpected person appears before him...!
t1567149.tmdb_overview_jp: 最強の仮面ライダー、ふたたび！  あの男たちが、20年の時を経て帰ってくる。そして伝説は未来へ……！  人間に擬態して地球侵略を進める宇宙生命体ワームに対抗するため、秘密組織ZECTが開発した「マスクドライダーシステム」。ワームとZECT、そしてマスクドライダー（仮面ライダー）たちの熾烈を極めた戦いは、人類の勝利に終わった、はずだったが……!?  多彩なキャラクターと、オリジナリティ溢れるストーリーの魅力で、現在も根強い人気を誇る『仮面ライダーカブト』。 20周年のアニバーサリーに、待望の完全新作が登場！ 人類とワームが共存する世界で、再始動したZECTの目的は？出現する、新たなマスクドライダーたち。 果たして「天を継ぐもの」は誰なのだろうか……！

t840873.movie_title: マルセル＆ムッシュ・パニョル
t840873.movie_title_jp: マルセル＆ムッシュ・パニョル
t840873.synopsis: 「ベルヴィル・ランデブー」「イリュージョニスト」などのアニメ作品で国際的に高く評価されてきたシルバン・ショメ監督が、フランスの国民的作家マルセル・パニョルの生涯を映画化した長編アニメーション。60代のマルセルが少年時代の自分とともに人生を振り返る姿を、リアルとファンタジーを融合させながらノスタルジックに描き出す。 1956年、パリ。小説家・劇作家・映画監督として成功をおさめた61歳のマルセル・パニョルは、雑誌連載の執筆を依頼される。書き出しに悩むマルセルの前に、少年時代の彼自身が突如として姿を現す。執筆を進めるにつれ、故郷プロヴァンスでの学生時代やパリでの教師時代、演劇界での作家デビューと映画監督としての活躍など、数々の思い出が鮮やかによみがえり、マルセルは少年時代の彼自身と2人でこれまでの歩みを振り返っていく。 成長したマルセル役で「アンタッチャブルズ」のローラン・ラフィットが声の出演。
t840873.synopsis_en: A feature-length animated film by director Sylvain Chomet, internationally acclaimed for animated works such as 'The Triplets of Belleville' and 'The Illusionist,' depicting the life of France's beloved author Marcel Pagnol. It nostalgically portrays the 60-something Marcel looking back on his life together with his boyhood self, blending reality and fantasy. Paris, 1956. Marcel Pagnol, 61, who has achieved success as a novelist, playwright, and film director, is asked to write a magazine serial. As Marcel struggles with how to begin, his boyhood self suddenly appears before him. As he proceeds with the writing, numerous memories vividly come back to life—his school days in his hometown of Provence, his time as a teacher in Paris, his debut as a writer in the theater world, and his success as a film director—and Marcel looks back on his journey together with his younger self. Laurent Lafitte of 'The Intouchables' voices the grown-up Marcel.
t840873.tmdb_overview_en: In 1955, 60-year-old Marcel Pagnol is a well-known and acclaimed playwright and filmmaker. When the editor-in-chief of ELLE magazine commissions a weekly column about Pagnol's childhood, he sees this as a great opportunity to go back to his artistic roots: writing. Realizing his memory is failing him and deeply affected by the disappointing results of his last two plays, Pagnol starts doubting his ability to pursue his work. That is until Little Marcel - the young boy he used to be - appears to him as if by magic. Together, they will explore Marcel Pagnol's incredible life and bring back to life his most cherished encounters and memories...

t936075.director: アントワン・フークア
t936075.synopsis: 圧倒的な歌唱力と革新的なダンスパフォーマンスで時代や国境を越えて愛され続ける「キング・オブ・ポップ」ことマイケル・ジャクソンの人生を描いた伝記映画。「トレーニング デイ」「イコライザー」シリーズのアントワン・フークア監督がメガホンをとり、音楽の枠を超えて世界に多大な影響を与えたマイケルの物語を、数々の名曲と共に描き出す。 野心家の父ジョセフのもとで厳しいレッスンを受け、兄弟グループ「ジャクソン5」のメンバーとして幼くして成功を収めたマイケル・ジャクソン。やがて名プロデューサーのクインシー・ジョーンズと出会った彼は、ソロアーティストとして数々の歴史的名曲を生み出し、瞬く間に時代の寵児となっていく。しかしその栄光の裏には、早熟の天才ゆえの孤独感や、強権的な父の呪縛、家族への愛と自分の中にあふれるビジョンとの間で葛藤するひとりの人間の姿があった。 主演にはマイケルの実の甥であるジャファー・ジャクソンを抜てきし、幼少期のマイケルをジュリアーノ・クルー・バルディ、父ジョセフをコールマン・ドミンゴ、母キャサリンをニア・ロング、音楽プロデューサーのクインシー・ジョーンズをケンドリック・サンプソン、長年の弁護士ジョン・ブランカをマイルズ・テラーが演じた。「グラディエーター」のジョン・ローガンが脚本を手がけ、製作には「ボヘミアン・ラプソディ」のグレアム・キングが名を連ねる。
t936075.synopsis_en: A biographical film depicting the life of Michael Jackson, the "King of Pop," beloved across eras and borders for his overwhelming vocal ability and innovative dance performances. Directed by Antoine Fuqua of "Training Day" and "The Equalizer" series, it portrays Michael's story—how he transcended music to greatly impact the world—alongside his many hit songs. Michael Jackson, under his ambitious father Joseph's strict training, achieved early success as a member of the Jackson 5. Meeting legendary producer Quincy Jones, he created numerous historic hits as a solo artist and quickly became the darling of his era. But behind the glory lay the loneliness of a precocious genius, the shackles of his authoritarian father, and the struggle between his love for his family and the visions overflowing within him. The film stars Michael's real-life nephew Jaafar Jackson as Michael, with Juliano Krue Valdi as young Michael, Colman Domingo as father Joseph, Nia Long as mother Katherine, Kendrick Sampson as Quincy Jones, and Miles Teller as longtime lawyer John Branca. The screenplay was written by John Logan of "Gladiator," and the film was produced by Graham King of "Bohemian Rhapsody."
t936075.tmdb_overview_en: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.
t936075.tmdb_overview_jp: 圧倒的な歌唱力と革新的なダンスパフォーマンスで、アーティストの枠を超え、全世界的なアイコンとなった“キング・オブ・ポップ”＝マイケル・ジャクソン。彼は幼いころから兄弟と共に歌い続けていた。製鉄所で働く父・ジョセフは野心家で、「人生は勝つか負けるかだ」と言い放ち、息子たちに厳しいレッスンを課し、兄弟グループ“ジャクソン５”としてデビューさせた。彼らをみた聴衆は誰しもマイケルの圧倒的な歌声に酔いしれた。評判は広まり、ステージからステージへ人気は急上昇、モータウン・レコードと契約し、スターダムを駆け上がっていく。しかし、喝采の裏で彼はまだ一人の少年だった。孤独と重圧の中、唯一無条件の愛で支え続けたのが母・キャサリンだった。やがて青年となったマイケルに運命の出会いが訪れる。音楽史にその名を刻む名プロデューサー、クインシー・ジョーンズ。彼との出会いによってマイケルはグループの枠を超え、ソロアーティストとして前人未踏の音楽的創造性を爆発させていく。『オフ・ザ・ウォール』『スリラー』、歴史的メガヒットアルバムと名曲の数々を生み出し、全世界の寵児となっていくマイケル。しかし、その栄光の裏には、早熟の天才ゆえの孤独感、強権的な父親の呪縛、家族への愛と自分の中に溢れるビジョンとの間で葛藤する一人の人間の姿があった… そして今、音楽史を塗り替える存在——“キング・オブ・ポップ”伝説誕生の瞬間へ。

t1807470.synopsis: 北海道釧路市を舞台に、人気RPGゲームのロケ誘致活動をきっかけに、幼なじみたちが街の未来のため奮闘する姿を描いたドラマ。監督は「ガメラ」シリーズや「デスノート」で知られる金子修介が務めた。 代わり映えのしない日々を送る釧路在住のゲームオタクの巌は、中学時代に友達と熱中した世界的ヒットゲーム「G.G.O.」の次回作の舞台候補地として、上海、釜山と並び、地元の釧路が挙がっていることを知る。市場で店を開く母と2人暮らしの巌は、ゲームの世界を通じて釧路の魅力を世界に発信することで観光客を増やそうと考え、東京から戻ってきた燈をはじめとする幼なじみたちとゲームのロケ誘致を目指して奮闘する。 巌役を「ほどなく、お別れです」「SAKAMOTO DAYS」の渡邊圭祐、燈役をNHK連続テレビ小説「わろてんか」の葵わかなが演じ、上川周作、小西桜子、萩原聖人、小林聡美らが顔をそろえる。「夜明けまでバス停で」「『桐島です』」の脚本を手がけ、自伝的エッセイ「爆弾犯の娘」が話題となった梶原阿貴が脚本を担当。
t1807470.synopsis_en: A drama set in Kushiro, Hokkaido, depicting childhood friends struggling for the city's future after a campaign to attract location shooting for a popular RPG game. Directed by Osamu Kaneko, known for the 'Gamera' series and 'Death Note.' Iwao, a game otaku living in Kushiro and leading unchanging days, learns that his hometown Kushiro is listed alongside Shanghai and Busan as a candidate location for the next installment of the worldwide hit game 'G.G.O.,' which he was obsessed with alongside friends in middle school. Iwao, who lives with his mother who runs a shop in the market, decides to spread Kushiro's appeal to the world through the game to increase tourists, and together with childhood friends including Akari, who has returned from Tokyo, he strives to attract the game's location shooting. Iwao is played by Keisuke Watanabe of 'Soon, We'll Part' and 'SAKAMOTO DAYS,' and Akari by Wakana Aoi of the NHK morning drama 'Warotenka,' with Shusaku Kamikawa, Sakurako Konishi, Masato Hagiwara, and Satomi Kobayashi rounding out the cast. The screenplay is by Aki Kajiwara, who wrote 'Until Dawn at the Bus Stop' and 'It's Kirishima,' and whose autobiographical essay 'The Bomber's Daughter' became a topic of discussion.
t1807470.tmdb_overview_en: Reunited in their hometown of Kushiro by a bid to revive a once-beloved RPG sequel, a group of childhood friends fight for the future of their town.
t1807470.tmdb_overview_jp: 代わり映えのしない日々を送る釧路在住のゲームオタクの巌は、中学時代に友達と熱中した世界的ヒットゲーム「G.G.O.」の次回作の舞台候補地として、上海、釜山と並び、地元の釧路が挙がっていることを知る。市場で店を開く母と2人暮らしの巌は、ゲームの世界を通じて釧路の魅力を世界に発信することで観光客を増やそうと考え、東京から戻ってきた燈をはじめとする幼なじみたちとゲームのロケ誘致を目指して奮闘する。

t1788171.synopsis: 第76回NHK全国学校音楽コンクール中学校の部課題曲として制作され、第51回日本レコード大賞で優秀作品賞を受賞した「いきものがかり」の楽曲「YELL」に着想を得て、「カノン」「レディ加賀」の雑賀俊朗監督が描く音楽ヒューマンドラマ。鈴木京香が、タクトを振ることで生徒たちを輝かせる「魔法」を持つと言われた伝説の高校音楽教師・原田貴理子を演じる。 小さな音楽出版社に勤める記者の北村翔は、雑誌「音楽ジャーナル」の特集企画「伝説の音楽教師」で、全国合唱コンクールに数々の優勝をもたらし「優勝請負人」と呼ばれた原田貴理子を取り上げることになる。しかし貴理子は突然教職を退き、消息を絶っていた。実は北村にとって貴理子はかつての恩師。当時の合唱仲間とともに記憶をたどりながら、北村は貴理子が姿を消した理由に迫っていく。 伝説の音楽教師と呼ばれる原田貴理子役を演じた鈴木京香は、指揮やピアノのレッスンを重ねて撮影に臨んだ。そのほか、北村役を藤原大祐、北村に取材を命じる編集長役を小泉今日子が演じ、榊原郁恵、小西博之、宅麻伸、名取裕子らが共演。監督・脚本は「カノン」「レディ加賀」の雑賀俊朗。「YELL」のミュージックビデオの撮影地でもある神奈川県厚木市の市制70周年記念事業のひとつとして制作され、厚木市内でオールロケを敢行した。
t1788171.synopsis_en: A music human drama directed by Toshiro Saiga of "Canon" and "Lady Kaga," inspired by the song "YELL" by Ikimonogakari, which was produced as the set piece for the junior high school division of the 76th NHK National School Music Competition and won the Excellent Work Award at the 51st Japan Record Awards. Kyoka Suzuki plays Kiyoko Harada, a legendary high school music teacher said to possess the "magic" to make students shine by waving her baton. Sho Kitamura, a journalist working at a small music publisher, is assigned to cover Kiyoko Harada—known as the "victory contractor" who led numerous national chorus competition championships—for a feature in the magazine "Music Journal" titled "Legendary Music Teachers." However, Kiyoko suddenly retired from teaching and disappeared. In fact, Kiyoko was once Kitamura's beloved teacher. Together with his former chorusmates, Kitamura retraces his memories and closes in on the reason Kiyoko vanished. Kyoka Suzuki, who played the legendary music teacher Kiyoko Harada, underwent conducting and piano lessons in preparation for filming. Also appearing are Daisuke Fujiwara as Kitamura, Kyoko Koizumi as the editor-in-chief who assigns Kitamura the story, and Ikue Sakakibara, Hiroyuki Konishi, Shin Takuma, and Yuko Natori in supporting roles. Directed and written by Toshiro Saiga of "Canon" and "Lady Kaga." Produced as part of the 70th anniversary commemorative projects for Atsugi City, Kanagawa Prefecture—also the filming location for the "YELL" music video—the film was shot entirely on location in Atsugi.
t1788171.tmdb_overview_en: Years after graduating from high school, music journalist Shō Kitamura is assigned to write about his former teacher, Kiriko Harada, a legendary choir instructor known for inspiring troubled students with her remarkable conducting and unwavering belief in them. But Kiriko has retired and mysteriously disappeared. As Shō reunites with former choir classmates and retraces their memories of their beloved teacher, he begins to uncover the story behind her disappearance and the profound impact she had on their lives. Inspired by Ikimonogakari’s hit song “YELL,” Echoes of Kiriko is a heartfelt drama about music, friendship, hope, and the enduring bond between a teacher and her students.

t1393151.director: デビッド・ボレンスタイン
t1393151.synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
t1393151.synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.
t1393151.tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.

t1651263.synopsis: 第66回江戸川乱歩賞作家・佐野広実の同名小説を、吉岡里帆と奈緒のダブル主演で映画化し、配偶者や親から暴力を受ける女性たちが身を寄せるシェルターを舞台に描くクライムサスペンス。「君は永遠にそいつらより若い」の吉野竜平が監督・脚本を手がけた。 夫の暴力から逃れた紀子は行き場を失い、看護師の路子に救われて三浦海岸の外れに建つ日本家屋のシェルター「おうち」へ連れられる。配偶者や親から暴力を受けた女性たちを匿うその場所では、食事や掃除など暮らしのすべてが「持ち回り」というルールで成り立っていた。穏やかで守られた日々を取り戻していく紀子だったが、少しずつその日常に違和感を覚え始める。そして、ついに「おうち」で行われている組織的犯罪の実態を知ってしまう。一方、ある事件を追う刑事・薫もまた、捜査線上に「おうち」の存在を浮かび上がらせていた。 「正体」で第48回日本アカデミー賞最優秀助演女優賞を受賞した吉岡里帆が紀子を、東京ドラマアウォード2025主演女優賞を受賞した奈緒が刑事・薫を演じた。風吹ジュン、美保純、酒井若菜、ファーストサマーウイカ、佐月絵美ら個性豊かな顔ぶれが「おうち」の女性たちを演じ、北村匠海、原嘉孝、清水尚弥が女性たちを脅かす人物たちを演じる。
t1651263.synopsis_en: A crime suspense film adaptation of the novel of the same name by Hiroshi Sano, winner of the 66th Edogawa Ranpo Award, starring Riho Yoshioka and Nao in a double lead, set in a shelter where women suffering violence from spouses or parents take refuge. Directed and written by Ryuhei Yoshino of "You Are Younger Than Those Guys Forever." Noriko, who escaped her husband's violence, loses her place and is saved by nurse Michiko, who brings her to "Ouchi," a shelter in a Japanese-style house on the outskirts of Miura Beach. At that place, which shelters women who have suffered violence from spouses or parents, everything in daily life—cooking, cleaning, and so on—is governed by a rule of "taking turns." Noriko regains a peaceful, protected daily life, but gradually begins to feel something off about that routine. And finally, she learns the truth of the organized crime being carried out at "Ouchi." Meanwhile, Detective Kaoru, pursuing a certain case, also begins to see the existence of "Ouchi" emerge in her investigation. Riho Yoshioka, who won the Best Supporting Actress award at the 48th Japan Academy Awards for "Identity," plays Noriko, and Nao, who won the Best Actress award at the 2025 Tokyo Drama Award, plays Detective Kaoru. Jun Fubuki, Jun Miho, Wakana Sakai, First Summer Uika, Emi Satsuki, and other colorful faces play the women of "Ouchi," while Takumi Kitamura, Yoshitaka Hara, and Naoya Shimizu play the figures who threaten the women.
t1651263.tmdb_overview_jp: 吉岡里帆×奈緒 W主演 2026年全国公開映画『シャドウワーク』
