t1443940.movie_title_jp: 真実と反逆　ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス
t1443940.clean_title_jp: 真実と反逆 ～ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス～
t1443940.synopsis: 第2次世界大戦下のドイツを舞台に、ナチスの真実を伝えるべく立ち上がった若きレジスタンスの命をかけた闘いを描いたヒューマンドラマ。ナチス政権下のドイツで反逆罪で処刑された実在の最年少レジスタンス、ヘルムス・ヒューブナーを題材に、「国家の圧力」と「自らの信念」との激しい衝突を描き出す。 1941年、第2次世界大戦下のドイツ。16歳の少年ヘルムス・ヒューブナーは、教会でナチス政権への服従を促され、ヒトラーの圧政に疑問を抱くようになる。ユダヤ人の迫害を目の当たりにしたことをきっかけに、禁止されていた海外のラジオ放送を聴いた彼は、国家が隠し続けてきた戦争の実態や残虐行為を知ってしまう。正義感に突き動かされたヘルムスは親友2人を仲間に加え、国家の嘘を暴くビラを町中に配布し、人々に真実を伝えていく。しかしその行為は、死刑に値する反逆罪だった。秘密国家警察の捜査が迫るなか、彼らの勇気ある行動は逃れられない運命へと突き進んでいく。 2002年にヘルムス・ヒューブナーの実像に迫ったドキュメンタリー作品を手がけたマット・ウィテカーが監督・脚本・製作を手がけ、同作の取材成果をもとに物語を再構築し劇映画として完成させた。
t1443940.synopsis_en: A human drama set in Germany during World War II, depicting the life-risking struggle of a young resistance fighter who stood up to tell the truth about the Nazis. Based on Helmuth Hübener, the youngest real-life resistance member executed for treason under the Nazi regime, it portrays the fierce clash between 'state pressure' and 'personal conviction.' In 1941, Germany during World War II. Sixteen-year-old Helmuth Hübener is urged at church to submit to the Nazi regime and begins to question Hitler's tyranny. After witnessing the persecution of Jews, he listens to forbidden foreign radio broadcasts and learns of the war's true state and atrocities that the state had kept hidden. Driven by a sense of justice, Helmuth recruits two close friends and distributes leaflets exposing the state's lies throughout town, spreading the truth to the people. But that act was treason, punishable by death. As the Secret State Police close in, their courageous actions hurtle toward an inescapable fate. Matt Whitaker, who directed a 2002 documentary exploring the real Helmuth Hübener, serves as director, screenwriter, and producer, reconstructing the story based on that film's research into a feature film.
t1443940.tmdb_overview_en: In 1941 Nazi Germany, 16-year-old Helmuth Hübener begins questioning the regime after learning the truth about the war and seeing his Jewish friend persecuted. With two friends, he secretly listens to banned foreign broadcasts and distributes leaflets exposing Nazi lies. As the Gestapo closes in, the teenagers face mounting danger for choosing conscience over obedience. Based on the true story of one of Germany’s youngest resistance fighters.

nジャイアント.director: としても知られる名演出家ニコラス・ハイトナーが演出を担った。
nジャイアント.synopsis: ロンドン・ウエストエンドやニューヨーク・ブロードウェイで大きな話題を呼んだ舞台「ジャイアント」を映像収録しスクリーン上映。「チャーリーとチョコレート工場」の原作小説などで知られるイギリスの児童文学作家ロアルド・ダールを主人公に、彼のキャリアを揺るがした実在のスキャンダルを描く。 1983年、イギリス。著名な児童文学作家ロアルド・ダールは、反ユダヤ主義的な内容の記事を書いたことで批判を浴びていた。ダールは自宅を訪ねてきた出版関係者たちを相手に、緊迫した会話を繰り広げる。 「教皇選挙」などの名優ジョン・リスゴーが実在の作家ロアルド・ダールを演じ、ウエストエンド公演でローレンス・オリビエ賞の最優秀主演男優賞、ブロードウェイ公演でトニー賞の主演男優賞（戯曲部門）に輝いた。20年以上にわたりイギリス演劇界で活躍してきた演出家マーク・ローゼンブラットが脚本を手がけ、初戯曲にしてローレンス・オリビエ賞の最優秀新作戯曲賞を受賞。「英国万歳！」「ミス・シェパードをお手本に」など映画監督としても知られる名演出家ニコラス・ハイトナーが演出を担った。
nジャイアント.synopsis_en: A filmed recording of the stage play "Giant," which caused a sensation in London's West End and on New York's Broadway, screened in theaters. Centering on Roald Dahl, the British children's author known for the original novel of "Charlie and the Chocolate Factory" and other works, it depicts a real-life scandal that shook his career. England, 1983. The celebrated children's author Roald Dahl has come under fire for writing an article with antisemitic content. Dahl engages in tense conversation with the publishing figures who visit his home. The renowned actor John Lithgow, known for "Conclave" and other works, plays the real-life author Roald Dahl, a performance that won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best Actor in the West End production and the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play on Broadway. The screenplay is by Mark Rosenblatt, a director active in British theater for over 20 years, and his first play won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Play. The production is directed by Nicholas Hytner, a renowned director also known as a filmmaker for "The Madness of King George" and "The Lady in the Van."

t84892.movie_title_en: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
t84892.movie_title_original: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
t84892.director: スティーブン・チョボウスキー
t84892.synopsis: 1999年にアメリカで出版され、「ライ麦畑でつかまえて」の再来とも言われたベストセラー青春小説を、原作者のスティーブン・チョボウスキーが自らのメガホンで映画化。「三銃士　王妃の首飾りとダ・ヴィンチの飛行船」のローガン・ラーマン、「ハリー・ポッター」シリーズのエマ・ワトソン、「少年は残酷な弓を射る」のエズラ・ミラーが共演する。小説家を志望する16歳の少年チャーリーは、高校入学初日にスクールカースト最下層に位置付けられてしまう。誰からも話しかけられず、「壁の花（Wallflower）」のようにひっそりと息を潜めて毎日をやり過ごすことに注力していたチャーリーだったが、陽気なパトリックとその妹で美しく奔放なサムに出会い、生活が一変。初めて友情や恋を知るが、過去のある事件をきっかけに、3人の青春の日々は思わぬ方向へ転がり始める。
t84892.synopsis_en: A coming-of-age film adapting Stephen Chbosky's bestselling novel, starring Logan Lerman. It sentimentally depicts the tragicomic events that befall a high school student who, after meeting a cheerful and dazzling pair of siblings, experiences friendship and love for the first time.
t84892.tmdb_overview_en: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, 1991. High school freshman Charlie is a wallflower, always watching life from the sidelines, until two senior students, Sam and her stepbrother Patrick, become his mentors, helping him discover the joys of friendship, music and love.
t84892.tmdb_overview_jp: スティーヴン・チョボスキーによるベストセラー小説を、ローガン・ラーマン主演で映像化した青春映画。陽気でまばゆい兄妹と出会い、初めての友情と恋を知った高校生に降りかかる悲喜劇をセンチメンタルに描く。

nblueheronブルーヘロン.director: ソフィー・ロムヴァリ
nblueheronブルーヘロン.synopsis:
世界各地で絶賛と共感！
新鋭ソフィー・ロムヴァリが描く、ある家族を巡る
今年もっとも胸を締めつける物語
nblueheronブルーヘロン.synopsis_en: In the summer of the late 1990s, eight-year-old Sasha moves to Vancouver Island, Canada, with her family of Hungarian immigrants. Surrounded by rich nature, Sasha gradually finds her place while spending time with her older brothers and new friends. However, her eldest brother Jeremy repeatedly engages in 'problem behavior,' and the family is reaching its limit. As the parents consult experts about Jeremy's problems, they are forced to make a difficult choice. Twenty years later, Sasha, now a film director, begins tracing her family's past with a camera in hand—

t1411007.director: アナスタシア・ミロシュニチェンコ
t1411007.synopsis: 山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2025（25年10月9～16日）インターナショナル・コンペティション部門上映作品。
t1411007.synopsis_en: Screening in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2025 (October 9–16, 2025).
t1411007.tmdb_overview_en: Katya is a young woman and a professional welder. Abandoned as a little girl, she embarks on a personal journey to reunite with her lost family, and weld it together, like she welds metal at work. Yet what she discovers down the road is about to make her relive the early childhood trauma.

t4972.director: アナス・トマス・イェンセン
t4972.synopsis: デンマークの人気俳優マッツ・ミケルセンが主演を務め、精肉店で客に人肉を提供する羽目になった男たちの奮闘を描いたデンマーク製ブラックコメディ。 精肉店を開業したスヴェンとビャンは、冷凍庫に閉じ込められていた電気工の死体を発見する。ひょんなことから、スヴェンは死体の肉でマリネを作り客に提供するが、なんとそのメニューが大人気となってしまう。店の評判を失いたくない彼は、材料を調達するべく次々と人間を手にかけていく。 町の嫌われ者スヴェンをミケルセンが独特のヘアスタイルで怪演し、「特捜部Q」シリーズのニコライ・リー・カースが相棒ビャンを演じた。監督・脚本は、「アダムズ・アップル」など数多くの作品でミケルセンと組むアナス・トマス・イェンセン。日本では、マッツ・ミケルセン出演作の特集上映企画「北欧の至宝　マッツ・ミケルセン生誕60周年祭」にて、2025年11月に劇場初公開。
t4972.synopsis_en: Popular Danish actor Mads Mikkelsen stars in this Danish black comedy about the struggles of two men who find themselves serving human meat to their customers. After opening their own butcher shop, Sven and Bjarne discover the body of an electrician who had been accidentally locked in their freezer. Through a bizarre turn of events, Sven prepares a marinade using the corpse’s meat and serves it to a customer, only for the dish to become an unexpected sensation. Desperate to maintain the shop’s reputation, he begins killing people one after another to procure more "ingredients." Mikkelsen delivers an eccentric performance as the town outcast Sven, sporting a unique hairstyle, while Nikolaj Lie Kaas of the "Department Q" series plays his partner, Bjarne. The film is written and directed by Anders Thomas Jensen, who has collaborated with Mikkelsen on numerous works, including "Adam's Apples." In Japan, the film will receive its first theatrical release in November 2025 as part of the special screening project "The Treasure of Scandinavia: Mads Mikkelsen's 60th Anniversary Festival."
t4972.tmdb_overview_jp: 開店休業状態の肉屋のスヴェンとビャン。誤って人を巨大冷凍庫に閉じ込めて殺してしまったスヴェンは、死体の肉をマリネにして売るが、評判を呼んでしまい……恐怖のホラー作品。

t1069537.synopsis: 華やかなK-POPの世界で挫折した元アイドル3人の“その後”をリアルに描いたドラマ。 スミン、テヒ、サランの3人は、競争の激しいK-POPアイドル界での成功を目指し青春のすべてを捧げてきたが、思い描いていたような成功をつかむことができないまま、それぞれのグループは解散し、夢も未来も見失ってしまう。途方に暮れた3人は、学生時代に行くことができなかった卒業旅行をやり直すべく、全財産の10万円を手に済州島へ向かう。さまざまなトラブルに見舞われながらも、みかん畑でのアルバイトや旅先で出会った人々との交流を通して、3人は傷ついた自分自身と向き合い、新たな一歩を踏み出していく。 監督・脚本は「告白ヒストリー」のナムグン・ソン。現役アイドルや元アイドルへの取材を重ね、K-POPアイドル産業が抱える問題に鋭く切り込みながら、自分たちの人生を取り戻していく元アイドルたちの姿を鮮やかに映し出す。出演はテレビドラマ「アンナラスマナラ　魔法の旋律」のチェ・ソンウン、「君と僕の5分」のヒョン・ウソク、「殺人配信」のハ・ソユン。2024年・第25回全州国際映画祭の韓国コンペティションでグランプリを含む3部門を受賞。あいち国際女性映画祭2025および第38回東京国際映画祭では「強くなるとき」のタイトルで上映。
t1069537.synopsis_en: This film, which achieved a triple crown including the Grand Prize at the Jeonju International Film Festival, depicts the "aftermath" of three former idols whose dreams were shattered in the dazzling world of K-POP. The three, who have lost sight of both their dreams and their future, embark on a belated "graduation trip." Facing their wounds, their lives that had come to a standstill begin to move once more. At the helm is director Namgung Sun of "Confession History." Through meticulous research and interviews with current and former idols, the film sharply examines the issues facing the K-POP idol industry—the fierce competition behind the glamorous stage, the financial burdens, and the reality of young people whose minds and bodies are worn down. At the same time, this is not merely a story that indicts the industry's harshness. How do young people who devoted their youth to a dream yet could not become "someone" go on to live? Without sensationally consuming their setbacks and pain, at times with humor and with a warm gaze, the film vividly captures these individuals reclaiming their own lives. The cast brings together a gathering of highly acclaimed young talents: Choi Sung-eun of "Anna: The Magic Melody," Hyun Woo-suk of "Five Minutes Between You and Me," and Ha So-yun of "Murder Livestream." Stopping in their tracks, wounded, yet sharing their vulnerability with others to walk forward once more—the three's belated "graduation trip" gradually transforms into a journey to begin life anew. A moving masterpiece that gently resonates with the paths each viewer has walked. To everyone who has ever stumbled and come to a standstill in life. A story for those of us who could not become "someone," about living as ourselves.
t1069537.tmdb_overview_en: Three retired K-pop idols take a trip to Jeju Island. After failed careers and missed school trips, they finally have the time to go on a trip on their own. On their first day on the island, things start to go awry.

t1808040.tmdb_overview_en: Yoshiko is an actress working on an indie film while living with her elderly father. In her latest role, she plays the wife of an eccentric man running for local political office, a fictional situation that gradually begins to overlap with the circumstances of her own everyday existence. As she moves between the demands of the film set and her domestic responsibilities, the distinction between performance and reality becomes increasingly uncertain.

t1510327.movie_title_en: Catching the Stars of This Summer
t1510327.synopsis: 直木賞受賞作家・辻村深月の同名小説を映画化し、コロナ禍で複雑な思いを抱える中高生たちの青春を、東京都渋谷区、茨城県土浦市、長崎県五島市を舞台に描いたドラマ。 2020年。新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大により登校や部活動が制限されるなか、茨城県立砂浦高校の天文部に所属する2年生・溪本亜紗の提案で、リモート会議を活用し、各地で同時に天体観測をする競技「オンラインスターキャッチコンテスト」が実施されることになる。長崎の五島列島や東京都心の生徒たちも参加してスタートしたこの活動はやがて全国へと拡がり、ある奇跡を起こす。 「交換ウソ日記」の桜田ひよりが亜紗役で主演を務め、亜紗の同級生役で水沢林太郎、長崎の学生役で中野有紗、早瀬憩、東京の学生役で黒川想矢、星乃あんな、亜紗が所属する天文部の顧問役で岡部たかしが共演。2019年のショートフィルム「ワンナイトのあとに」や配信ドラマ「今日も浮つく、あなたは燃える」で話題を集めた山元環が長編商業映画初監督を務め、ドラマ「ケの日のケケケ」の森野マッシュが脚本を担当。「ルックバック」のharuka nakamuraが音楽を手がけた。
t1510327.synopsis_en: A drama based on the award-winning novel by Mizuki Tsujimura, depicting the complex emotions of junior high and high school students during the COVID-19 pandemic, set in Tokyo's Shibuya Ward, Tsuchiura City in Ibaraki Prefecture, and Goto City in Nagasaki Prefecture. In 2020, with school attendance and club activities restricted due to the pandemic, Aya Tanimoto, a second-year student in the astronomy club at Ibaraki Prefectural Sunaura High School, proposes an 'Online Star Catch Contest'—a competition using remote meetings to conduct simultaneous astronomical observations across different locations. The activity, joined by students from the Goto Islands in Nagasaki and central Tokyo, eventually spreads nationwide and sparks a miracle. Hiyori Sakurada, known for 'The Fake Diary,' stars as Aya. Rinataro Mizusawa plays her classmate; Arisa Nakano and Ikoi Hayase play students from Nagasaki; Soiya Kurokawa and Anna Hoshino play students from Tokyo; and Takashi Okabe plays the astronomy club advisor. Tamaki Yamamoto, who gained attention for the 2019 short film 'One Night After' and the streaming drama 'Today You're Restless, You're Burning,' makes his feature-length commercial film debut as director. Mash Morino, known for the drama 'Keke no Hi no Kekeke,' writes the screenplay. Haruka Nakamura, known for 'Look Back,' provides the music.
t1510327.tmdb_overview_en: During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, when club activities were restricted, Japanese students launched an astronomical observation event called the "Star Catch Contest" via remote meetings. What began as a collaboration between students from Ibaraki, Tokyo, and Nagasaki's Goto Islands soon spread nationwide, leading to an unexpected miracle.

t51808.synopsis: ヌーベルバーグを代表する 6 人の監督が、それぞれパリの街を舞台に撮りあげた短編オムニバス映画。 歓楽街で出会った娼婦を自宅に連れ込んだ気弱な男性を描く「サンドニ街」（ジャン＝ダニエル・ポレ監督）、駅から離れたアパートで恋人と暮らす女性が、彼と口論して怒りを抱えたまま出勤する途中で思わぬ出来事に遭う「北駅」（ジャン・ルーシュ監督）、学生街を舞台に繰り広げられる若者たちの恋愛模様をつづった「サンジェルマン・デ・プレ」（ジャン・ドゥーシェ監督）、エトワール広場を通って職場へ向かう男性が次々とトラブルに見舞われる「エトワール広場」（エリック・ロメール監督）、2 人の相手にそれぞれラブレターを書いた女性が中身を取り違えてポストに投函してしまう「モンパルナスとルヴァロワ」（ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール監督）、高級住宅街に暮らすブルジョワ家庭を襲う悲劇を息子の視点から描いた「ラ・ミュエット」（クロード・シャブロル監督）の全 6 話で構成。 出演は「冒険者たち」のジョアンナ・シムカス、「バベットの晩餐会」のステファーヌ・オードラン、本作の製作も手がけるバーベット・シュローダーほか。
t51808.synopsis_en: An omnibus film of short works, each directed by one of six leading directors of the French New Wave, all set against the backdrop of Paris. The six episodes are: "Saint-Denis Street" (directed by Jean-Daniel Pollet), about a timid man who brings a prostitute he met in a red-light district back to his apartment; "North Station" (Jean Rouch), about a woman living with her lover in an apartment far from the station who encounters an unexpected incident on her way to work after arguing with him; "Saint-Germain-des-Prés" (Jean Douchet), depicting the romantic entanglements of young people in a student quarter; "Place de l'Étoile" (Éric Rohmer), about a man heading to work through the Place de l'Étoile who faces a series of troubles; "Montparnasse and Levallois" (Jean-Luc Godard), about a woman who writes love letters to two different men but accidentally mails the wrong ones; and "La Muette" (Claude Chabrol), depicting a tragedy that strikes a bourgeois family in an upscale neighborhood from the son's perspective. The cast includes Joanna Shimkus from "The Adventurers," Stéphane Audran from "Babette's Feast," and Barbet Schroeder, who also produced this film, among others.
t51808.tmdb_overview_en: Six vignettes set in different sections of Paris, by six directors. St. Germain des Pres (Douchet), Gare du Nord (Rouch), Rue St. Denis (Pollet), and Montparnasse et Levallois (Godard) are stories of love, flirtation and prostitution; Place d'Etoile (Rohmer) concerns a haberdasher and his umbrella; and La Muette (Chabrol), a bourgeois family and earplugs.

t1654870.synopsis: 舘ひろしが主演を務め、70歳の映画スターが免許返納をめぐる大騒動に巻き込まれていく姿を描いたコメディ。 順風満帆な俳優人生を歩んできた南条弘は、最近では芸術映画でも数々の映画賞を獲得しているが、心の内ではアクション映画への出演を望んでいた。そんな中、若い頃からの腐れ縁である俳優仲間の尾崎誠がバイク事故を起こし、南条は同世代の俳優としてメディアからコメントを求められる。尾崎を諫める発言は世間から思いがけない注目を集め、ひとり歩きした論調は南条のマネージャーや家族も巻き込みながら、本来の意図とは異なる形で拡大解釈されていく。これからも車やバイクでのアクションを演じたい南条だったが、周囲からは免許返納を期待され、人生最大のピンチに陥ってしまう。 舘ひろしが1994年の映画「免許がない！」で演じた役と同名の俳優・南条弘をコミカルに演じ、南条に振り回されるマネージャー・川奈舞役で西野七瀬、南条との出会いで大きく人生が変わっていく青年・来宮亮役で黒川想矢、南条が所属する芸能事務所の社長・三宅篤役で吉田鋼太郎、南条とともに一時代を築いた俳優仲間・尾崎誠役で宇崎竜童が共演。「かぐや様は告らせたい　天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦」の河合勇人が監督を務め、「ラーゲリより愛を込めて」の林民夫が脚本を手がけた。
t1654870.synopsis_en: A comedy starring Hiroshi Tachi, depicting a 70-year-old movie star caught up in a major uproar over surrendering his driver's license. Nanjo Hiroshi, who has enjoyed a smooth acting career and recently won numerous film awards for art films, secretly longs to appear in action movies. When his longtime actor friend Ozaki Makoto gets into a motorcycle accident, Nanjo is asked by the media for comment as a fellow actor of the same generation. His remarks admonishing Ozaki unexpectedly attract public attention, and the narrative takes on a life of its own, involving his manager and family, and being interpreted in ways far from his original intent. Although Nanjo wants to continue performing action scenes with cars and motorcycles, those around him expect him to surrender his license, plunging him into the biggest crisis of his life. Hiroshi Tachi comically plays actor Nanjo Hiroshi, the same name as the character he played in the 1994 film "License!". Nishino Nanase plays his manager Kawauna Mai, who is thrown into chaos by Nanjo; Kurokawa Sooya plays young man Kugami Ryo, whose life changes dramatically after meeting Nanjo; Yoshida Kotaro plays Mita Atsushi, the president of Nanjo's talent agency; and Uzaki Ryudo plays Ozaki Makoto, an actor friend who built an era alongside Nanjo. Directed by Kawai Yuji of "Kaguya-sama: Love Is War" fame, with screenplay by Hayashi Tamio of "From the Land of Love to the Land of Sorrow".
t1654870.tmdb_overview_en: A veteran movie star faces a career crisis after a misinterpreted remark sparks public backlash and scrutiny over his driving and reputation.
t1654870.tmdb_overview_jp: 2026年6月19日に公開予定舘ひろし主演のアクションコメディ

t1783298.movie_title: バレンと小刀　時代をつなぐ浮世絵物語
t1783298.movie_title_jp: バレンと小刀　時代をつなぐ浮世絵物語
t1783298.movie_title_en: バレンと小刀 時代をつなぐ浮世絵物語
t1783298.clean_title_jp: バレンと小刀 時代をつなぐ浮世絵物語
t1783298.movie_title_original: バレンと小刀 時代をつなぐ浮世絵物語
t1783298.synopsis: 江戸の浮世絵技術を現代に受け継ぐ「アダチ版画研究所」で、現代アーティストの作品を版画にするプロジェクトに挑む職人たちの仕事を追ったドキュメンタリー。 江戸時代に隆盛を極め、ゴッホなど印象派の画家たちにも多大な影響を与えた浮世絵。1928年創業のアダチ版画研究所は浮世絵版画の技術を現代に継承し、これまで版元として江戸時代の名作の数々を復刻し国内外に届けてきた。近年、同研究所は、草間彌生、ロッカクアヤコ、ニック・ウォーカー、アントニー・ゴームリーら世界的に活躍する38名のアーティストを絵師に迎え、新たな現代の浮世絵を創作するプロジェクトに取り組んでいる。約5年かけて86作品を制作し、2025年春に東京国立博物館で開催される「浮世絵現代」展での発表を目指す。彫師と摺師たちは、古典的な浮世絵とは異なる世界観と多様な表現にたじろぎ、絵師の鋭い指摘に苦悩しながらも、職人としての矜持から粘り強く原画の美をすくいあげ、さらなる高みを求めて試行錯誤していく。 監督は「≒草間彌生　わたし大好き」「氷の花火　山口小夜子」の松本貴子。
t1783298.synopsis_en: A documentary following the craftsmen at the Adachi Institute of Woodcut Prints, who carry on Edo-period ukiyo-e techniques into the modern era, as they take on a project to transform works by contemporary artists into woodblock prints. Ukiyo-e flourished in the Edo period and greatly influenced Impressionist painters like Van Gogh. Founded in 1928, the Adachi Institute has preserved ukiyo-e print techniques, reproducing classic Edo masterpieces as a publisher and delivering them both domestically and internationally. In recent years, the institute has undertaken a project to create new contemporary ukiyo-e by inviting 38 globally active artists—including Yayoi Kusama, Ayako Rokkaku, Nick Walker, and Antony Gormley—as painters. Over about five years, they produce 86 works, aiming for presentation at the "Ukiyo-e Modern" exhibition at the Tokyo National Museum in spring 2025. The carvers and printers, daunted by worldviews and diverse expressions different from classical ukiyo-e, struggle under the artists' sharp critiques yet, driven by craftsman pride, tenaciously draw out the beauty of the original art, repeatedly experimenting in pursuit of higher heights. Directed by Takako Matsumoto, known for "≒Yayoi Kusama: I Love Me" and "Ice Fireworks: Sayoko Yamaguchi."
t1783298.tmdb_overview_en: Beyond Time and Space with Ukiyo-e

t39230.movie_title: 機動戦士ガンダムIII めぐりあい宇宙（そら）編
t39230.movie_title_jp: 機動戦士ガンダムIII めぐりあい宇宙（そら）編
t39230.movie_title_en: Mobile Suit Gundam III: Encounters in Space
t39230.clean_title_jp: 機動戦士ガンダム III めぐりあい宇宙編
t39230.movie_title_original: 機動戦士ガンダム III めぐりあい宇宙編
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t39230.synopsis: 1979～80年に放映されたTVアニメ「機動戦士ガンダム」を再編集した劇場3部作の第3部。再び宇宙へ戻ったホワイトベースは陽動部隊として作戦に従事するが、そんなホワイトベースを宿敵シャア・アズナブルが執拗に追跡していた。地球連邦軍の本隊がジオンの要塞ソロモンを攻略するにあたり、ホワイトベースはジオンの目をそらすために中立コロニー群のサイド6に進路を向ける。アムロはサイド6で父と再会するが、その変わり果てた姿に打ちひしがれる。そんな折、アムロは運命の女性ララァ・スンとの邂逅を果たす。ニュータイプとしての才能を開花させていくアムロは、やがて戦場でララァと相まみえることとなるが……。
t39230.synopsis_en: The third installment of the theatrical trilogy re-editing the TV anime "Mobile Suit Gundam" broadcast from 1979 to 1980. The White Base, having returned to space once more, engages in operations as a diversionary unit, but the White Base is relentlessly pursued by its sworn enemy Char Aznable. As the main Earth Federation Forces move to capture the Zeon fortress Solomon, the White Base sets course for the neutral colony cluster Side 6 in order to divert Zeon's attention. Amuro reunites with his father at Side 6, but is devastated by his father's transformed state. Around this time, Amuro encounters the woman of destiny, Lalah Sune. Amuro, blossoming his talent as a Newtype, eventually faces Lalah on the battlefield, but...
t39230.tmdb_overview_en: Amuro Ray and the rest of the White Base crew, now denominated the 13th Autonomous Corps, return to outer space to support the rest of the Earth Federation forces for the decisive battle against the Principality of Zeon's forces.
t39230.tmdb_overview_jp: ホワイトベースは、再び宇宙へと飛び立った。ニュータイプとして覚醒したアムロは、ガンダムで迫りくるジオン軍を次々と撃破、すさまじい戦果をあげていく。運命の少女ララァの乗るエルメスと交戦したとき、アムロの精神は、激しく共鳴をはじめた。だが、その戦いは、恐ろしい悲劇につながっていく。ひとの革新とは本当にあるのか?果てしなき喪失感を越えて、アムロの還える場所は…。

t10180.synopsis: . 本国で歴史的大ヒットを記録した デンマーク映画史上最高傑作とも言われる幻の名作 不条理な子供時代のトラウマを持ち、この上なくアンラッキーな4人のならず者たち。年齢も境遇もバラバラな彼らは失敗続きの人生を塗り変えるために大金強奪を画策する。激しい銃撃戦に負傷しながらも、逃亡を果たした彼らに待っていたのは…。 . マッツが演じるのはこんな役！ 暴力ですべてを解決する銃器マニア、いつもイライラしている荒くれ者アーニー 若きマッツの鍛え上げられた身体と、やんちゃな色気がたまらない…！ . .
t10180.synopsis_en:
A legendary masterpiece and a historic box-office smash, often called the greatest film in Danish cinema history.

Four supremely unlucky rogues, each haunted by absurd childhood traumas. Despite their different ages and backgrounds, they plot a massive heist to turn around their lives of constant failure. After surviving a fierce shootout and making their escape, what lies ahead for them is...

This is the role Mads plays! Arne, a gun-obsessed brute who solves every problem with violence and is constantly on edge. A young Mads’s ripped physique and mischievous sex appeal are simply irresistible...!

n原爆資料館.synopsis: 広島平和記念資料館の70年の歴史を辿るドキュメンタリー。歴代館長が命がけで守り続けた”歴史の現場”の全容と資料館に込められた思いを映し出す。
n原爆資料館.synopsis_en: A documentary tracing the 70-year history of the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum. It reveals the full picture of the "site of history" that successive directors risked their lives to protect, and the thoughts embedded in the museum.

t58833.synopsis: パリ18区。夜のガソリンスタンドで働く中年男のもとに青年が逃げ込んできて…。都市の周縁に追いやられた者たちの孤独を描く80年代のフレンチ・ノワール。
t58833.synopsis_en: A French noir directed by Claude Berri in 1983, known for 'The Old Man and the Child' and 'Jean de Florette'/'Manon des Sources,' which became a huge hit in France attracting nearly 4 million viewers. Set in the Parisian underworld, it vividly portrays the loneliness and sorrow of those cast out from the city through a tale of friendship and revenge between a lonely middle-aged man and a young drug dealer. In the 18th arrondissement of Paris, one night, a young man named Bensoussan, of Jewish and Arab descent, flees into the gas station where Lambert, an alcoholic middle-aged man, works. Bensoussan begins visiting Lambert frequently, and Lambert starts looking after him. However, Bensoussan, a drug dealer, is killed by two men on a motorcycle. Lambert swears revenge, takes a gun, and heads out into the night. French national comedian Coluche plays the protagonist Lambert, and Richard Anconina, known for 'The Pistol and the Boy,' plays Bensoussan. At the 9th César Awards, Coluche won Best Actor, and Anconina won Best Supporting Actor and Most Promising Actor. Based on the novel by Alain Page, known for 'The Sun Knows,' the screenplay was co-written by Page and director Berri. Scheduled for a revival release in Japan in July 2026 in a 4K digital version.
t58833.tmdb_overview_en: In the 18th Arrondissement of Paris, Lambert, an aloof garage manager working the night shift at a petrol station spends his time drinking on the job, content in his own company. One night, Bensoussan, a small-time drug pusher in dire straits falls in on a stolen moped pretending to need a spark plug. The two men develop an unlikely friendship.

エッセンシャル・
ヌーヴェルヴァーグ
nエッセンシャルヌーヴェルヴァーグ.movie_title_jp:
エッセンシャル・
ヌーヴェルヴァーグ

t1580162.synopsis_en: A horror film directed by Yoshizo Sakai of "Fictional" and "Counselor," planned and produced by Tokio Omori, a TV Tokyo producer who brought forth "The Missing Exhibit" and "Searching for Kikue Ishinaga." Rio Yamashita, who starred in the 2025 long-running hit "Yukiko a.k.a." primarily in mini-theaters over about a year, plays the lead role of a woman tormented by paranoid fear through caring for her mother. After her father's death, Kana returns to her childhood home and begins caring for her mother, who has dementia. She devotes herself to caregiving as if trying to reclaim time with her mother, but her mother's inexplicable behavior gradually becomes increasingly bizarre, and Kana begins to feel uneasy about strange occurrences around her. Eventually, possessed by the sensation that something has entered her mother's inner being, Kana is driven mad by the presence of an unearthly "something." In addition to Rio Yamashita as the protagonist Kana, An Ogawa, who has starred in successive films including "There Is a Stone" and "Song of the Beyond," plays Kana's younger sister Anri, who rushes to the family home after hearing Kana's pleas, and Sports Makita plays psychiatrist Kumagai, who becomes acquainted with Kana and Anri's family through a certain incident.
t1580162.tmdb_overview_en: After her father’s death, Kana returns home to care for her ailing mother. Soon, she begins experiencing vivid dreams and strange premonitions. When a dream about a high school classmate jumping in front of a train comes true, Kana’s anxiety spirals.

t172978.synopsis: 満月の翌朝、スイス各地で10歳の子供が失踪した。男女６人ずつ、４つの言語圏から均等に。警察もメディアも手がかりを掴めぬまま、事件は説明不可能な事態へと発展していく…。
t172978.synopsis_en: A 1998 fantasy film by Swiss filmmaker Fredi M. Murer, known for 'Höhenfeuer' and 'We, the Mountain People,' which allegorically depicts the mass disappearance of children. Through the form of fantasy, it portrays social issues still relevant today, such as the runaway collective psychology fueled by uncertain information and miscommunication within families. One morning after a full moon, ten-year-old children vanish across Switzerland: six boys and six girls, evenly selected from the four language regions. With police and media unable to find solid leads, the incident develops into an inexplicable situation. Reflecting the contradictions and anxieties lurking in society, the story moves toward the next full moon. Directed and written by Murer, with cinematography by Pio Corradi ('Höhenfeuer') and music by Mario Beretta. Starring Hanspeter Müller, Lilo Bauer, and Benedikt Freitag. It won the Grand Prix at the 1998 Montreal World Film Festival. Released in Japan in 2000, it will receive a special 35mm film screening in 2026 to coincide with the final Japanese screenings of Murer's documentary trilogy, the 'Mountain Trilogy.'
t172978.tmdb_overview_en: Fredi M. Murer wrote and directed this Swiss drama about a family with a missing child. The only explanation seems to be kidnapping, but no ransom note arrives. Police inspector Anatol Wasser (Hanspeter Muller) soon faces an elaborate mystery: a dozen Swiss children vanish with no indication of any pattern -- other than the fact that they all lived near lakes. Is organized crime responsible, or does the answer lie in mystical realms? Shown at the 1998 Montreal Film Festival.

t79116.movie_title_en: Beresina or The Last Days of Switzerland
t79116.movie_title_original: Beresina oder die letzten Tage der Schweiz
t79116.director: ダニエル・シュミット
t79116.synopsis: スイスの権力者から愛されるロシア人のコールガール、イリーナ。銀行の頭取、テレビ局の局長などがこぞって彼女の虜になった。中でも特別に彼女を愛したのは、元陸軍少尉のシュトゥルツェネガー。彼は彼女と、過去に彼が結成した秘密軍隊の暗号“ベレジーナ”を使った寸劇遊びに興じる。だがコールガールの彼女を仕切る政治家好きの夫婦は、彼女を利用して国の上層部に受け入れられようと必死になり…。
t79116.synopsis_en: Irina, a Russian call girl beloved by the powerful men of Switzerland. A bank president, a television station director, and others all fall under her spell. Among them, the one who loved her most specially was Sturzenegger, a former army lieutenant. He and she enjoy playing skits using "Berezina," the code name of a secret army he once formed. But the politically minded couple who manage her as a call girl desperately try to use her to gain acceptance into the country's upper echelons...
t79116.tmdb_overview_en: A naive girl's love for Switzerland is put to the test in this satiric comedy. Irina is a woman from Russia who all her life has always been fascinated by Switzerland and longs to live there some day, though her notion of Swiss life has more to do with Heidi and old movies set in the Alps than reality.
t79116.tmdb_overview_jp: スイスの経済弁護士ヴァルト博士（ウルリヒ・ノエテン）とファッション・デザイナーのシャルロッテ・デー（ジェラルディン・チャップリン）は権力に全ての生きがいを感じる人種で、金融界でも政界でもまともに相手にされてはいなかった。しかし、シャルロッテが抱えるコールガール、ロシア人のイリーナ（エレナ・パノーヴァ）は、権力者たちの寵愛を集めていた。次第に、博士とシャルロッテはそんな彼女に期待と私財をかけ、高級マンションを買い与えるや、彼女に語りかける男たちの機密のやりとりを盗聴しようとする。

t616610.director: フレディ・M・ムーラー
t616610.synopsis: 1988年、NAGRA（ナーグラ：国立放射性廃棄物管理協同組合）はニトヴァルデン準州ヴェレンベルクに原子力発電に使われた核の最終廃棄物処理場を建設する計画を発表し、地域住民の抗議団体が形成される。支持者と反対派にインタビューする。リサーチと議論は、直接影響を被る人々、ヴェレンベルクで数世代にわたって暮らしてきた家族に焦点を当てる。彼らは、放射線の危険性を目前にし、今や自身のルーツと生活の地を奪われることに直面している。さらに本作は、政治家、地質学者、医学者など様々な立場の人々の話から、一過的で限定された地域の問題にとどまらず、時間の尺度としては人間の寿命をはるかに超えたスケールの問題を提起する。ムーラーはこの作品を「子どもたちと子どもたちの子どもたち」に捧げており、次世代に対して責務を負うべき大人たちに、今日にも通じる問いを突きつける。
t616610.synopsis_en: A documentary by Swiss master director Fredi M. Murer, known for "Mountain Fire," investigating a planned radioactive waste disposal facility in the Alps. It follows both opponents and supporters among the residents trying to protect their roots and land. Murer dedicated this film "to the children and the children's children," posing questions to adults who should bear responsibility for the next generation. Along with "We Mountain People" and "Mountain Fire," it is considered part of the "Mountain Trilogy."
t616610.tmdb_overview_en: The NAGRA (Swiss National Association for the Storage of Radioactive Waste) plans to build a permanent waste disposal site in Wellenberg, Canton of Nidwalden. A regional citizens’ action group is formed to protest against it.

t133481.movie_title_jp: 東のエデン 総集編 Air Communication
t133481.movie_title_en: Eden of The East Compilation: Air Communication
t133481.clean_title_jp: 東のエデン 総集編 Air Communication
t133481.movie_title_original: 東のエデン 総集編 Air Communication
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t133481.synopsis_en: A compilation film of the TV anime of the same name broadcast in 2009. Kenji Kamiyama, director of the TV version, returns to reconstruct the TV series with an original screenplay. On Monday, November 22, 2010, missile attacks occur across Japan with zero casualties. The incident is dubbed 'Careless Monday,' but people gradually lose their sense of crisis. Three months later, Saki Morimi, a member of the university club 'Eden of the East' that develops mobile websites, meets a completely naked man named Akira Takizawa during a graduation trip to the United States.
t133481.tmdb_overview_en: A re-editing of the 11 television episodes of popular anime Higashi no Eden into a feature-length film.
t133481.tmdb_overview_jp: 2009年にTV放映された同名アニメの総集編。TV版の監督・神山健治が続投し、オリジナル脚本でTVシリーズを再構築する。2010年11月22日の月曜日、日本各地で犠牲者が1人も出ないミサイルテロが発生する。この事件は「迂闊な月曜日」と呼ばれたが、人々は次第に危機意識を失っていった。それから3ヵ月後、携帯サイトを開発する大学のサークル「東のエデン」に所属する森美咲は、卒業旅行で訪れたアメリカで、全裸の男・滝沢朗と出会う。

t104251.movie_title_en: Pastoral: To Die in the Country
t104251.program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
t104251.synopsis: かいせつ 多分野で活躍した演劇界の鬼才・寺山の長編映画第二作。時空を越えた寺山の自伝的原風景を、幻想的で儚い鮮烈なイメージの連続で描く。
t104251.synopsis_en: An autobiographical work written and directed by Shuji Terayama, adapting his own poetry collection of the same name. In a village at the foot of Mount Osore in Aomori Prefecture, a young boy, 'I', lives with his mother in an old house after losing his father. The boy's only solace is having an itako (a spirit medium) summon his father's spirit to talk to him. A beautiful woman who marries into the neighboring house and a circus troupe that comes to the village tempt the boy to run away from home. Later, 'I' grows up, moves to Tokyo, becomes middle-aged, and makes a film. Before this 'I' appears the boy he once was... Kantaro Suga, known for 'Thirteen Assassins' and others, plays the lead, and Kaoru Yachigusa plays the neighbor's wife.
t104251.tmdb_overview_en: A director faces creative block while working on his latest film – a reimagination of his adolescence growing up in a mountain village in rural Japan.
t104251.tmdb_overview_jp: 「恐山」「母殺し」「家出」など寺山特有のテーマが多く取り上げられており、自伝的要素が見られるが、劇中劇が用いられるなど虚構の性格が強い作品である。先行して刊行された同名の歌集からの短歌が、映画の中でも朗読される。 菅貫太郎唯一の映画主演作である。ラストシーンは『幕末太陽傳』（の実現しなかった結末案）から影響を受けたといわれる。

t189025.program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
t189025.synopsis: かいせつ 脅迫状が届いた人妻に相談された推理小説家は…。複雑な謎と耽美に彩られた乱歩ミステリーを、加藤泰が大胆なエロスと映像表現で描く異色作。
t189025.synopsis_en: A mystery novelist consulted by a married woman who has received a threatening letter... Kato Tai boldly depicts Ranpo's mystery, adorned with intricate puzzles and aestheticism, through audacious eroticism and visual expression in this unconventional work.
t189025.tmdb_overview_en: In 1930, the chance meeting of a novelist and one of his fans opens the door to a series of mysterious events culminating in the death of a wealthy industrialist who may have been leading a double life.
t189025.tmdb_overview_jp: 探偵作家の寒川が静子というファンと出会う。彼女は変革派作家の大江春泥から脅迫されており、ほどなく静子の夫が殺害されて……。江戸川乱歩の「陰獣」を、あおい輝彦、香山美子の顔合わせで映画化したミステリー。

t78386.program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
t78386.synopsis: かいせつ 「こんな夢を見た。」で始まる漱石の短編10作をそれぞれ別の監督で映画化。美しくも恐ろしい夢幻の世界を斬新な映像で綴ったオムニバス作品。
t78386.synopsis_en: Ten short stories by Soseki, each beginning with 'I had a dream like this,' are adapted into film by different directors. An omnibus work that weaves a beautiful yet terrifying dreamlike world through innovative imagery.
t78386.tmdb_overview_en: Based on renowned Japanese writer Natsume Soseki's same-titled short story collection, Ten Nights of Dreams brings ten fantastical dream sequences to film with great visual and psychological panache. Representing the combined efforts of eleven directors, this outstanding anthology delves into the surreal subconscious with ten madly imaginative, reality-subverting visions that range from wonderfully wacky to nightmarishly unsettling.
t78386.tmdb_overview_jp: 文豪・夏目漱石の異色短編「夢十夜」を、実相寺昭雄、市川崑、清水崇をはじめとする10人の監督が大胆な解釈、奔放なイマジネーションを駆使して映像化した。

t1418569.movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
t1418569.synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.
t1418569.tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.

t1140724.movie_title: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
t1140724.movie_title_jp: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
t1140724.clean_title_jp: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
t1140724.synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.
t1140724.tmdb_overview_en: Who said living with disabilities meant giving up one’s greatest dreams? Across the world, Pascal Plisson met Maud (France), Charles (Kenya), Nirmala and Khendo (Nepal), Xavier (Rwanda) and Antonio (Brazil) : extraordinary children who will prove that love, inclusive education, humour and courage can move mountains, and that fate is sometimes full of surprises.

t1023.synopsis: . 試練と不条理の果てに予期せぬ“奇跡”が舞い降りる 予測不能なダークヒューマンドラマ 仮釈放されたアダムは更生施設を兼ねた田舎の教会へ送り込まれるが、ネオナチ思想に染まる彼は、指導役の聖職者イヴァンから目標を問われ「庭のリンゴを収穫してアップルケーキを作る」と適当な返事をする。イヴァンの自己欺瞞を執拗に暴こうとするアダムだったが、そんな彼に奇怪な災いが次々と降りかかる...。 . マッツが演じるのはこんな役！ 穏やかながら度を越えた楽観主義者、短パン姿の型破りな牧師イヴァン ポジティブ思考の良識人のようだが、徐々にサイコパス味が増してきて…。 . . .
t1023.synopsis_en: A human drama written and directed by Anders Thomas Jensen, the acclaimed screenwriter of *Open Hearts* and *Brothers*, starring Mads Mikkelsen (*The Hunt*). Drawing motifs from the Old Testament’s "Book of Job" and the fable of Adam’s apples, the film uses dark humor to depict the eccentric characters inhabiting a rural church. Adam, a neo-Nazi skinhead on parole, is sent to a countryside church that doubles as a rehabilitation center. When his mentor, the priest Ivan, asks him to set a goal, Adam dismissively replies that he will bake an apple cake using fruit from the garden. The residents of the church are all peculiar, including Ivan himself, who uses blind faith to shield himself from a harsh reality. As Adam relentlessly attempts to strip away Ivan’s self-deception, a series of bizarre calamities begins to plague him. Ulrich Thomsen (*In a Better World*) stars as Adam, with Mikkelsen portraying Ivan.

t307034.tmdb_overview_en: A hard-working section chief, fast approaching retirement and beset by stress from all directions, joins a jazz band and reignites his youthful passion for the music, giving him a chance to set things right in his life.

t307039.movie_title: 竜馬の妻とその夫と愛人
t307039.movie_title_jp: 竜馬の妻とその夫と愛人
t307039.movie_title_en: Ryoma's Wife, Her Husband and Her Lover
t307039.clean_title_jp: 竜馬の妻とその夫と愛人
t307039.movie_title_original: 竜馬の妻とその夫と愛人
t307039.synopsis_en: Thirteen years have passed since Ryoma was assassinated. Kanno Kakubei, an official of the new government, visits Oryo—Ryoma Sakamoto's former wife and his elder sister-in-law—in order to hold the thirteenth memorial service for his mentor and brother-in-law Sakamoto Ryoma. Oryo has impulsively remarried an unremarkable man named Matsuhei Nishimura and lives in poverty in a run-down tenement. However, in truth, Oryo already has a lover named Torazo who looks exactly like Ryoma. Oryo may have remarried Matsuhei, but she has grown thoroughly disgusted with her impoverished and boring life, and was about to elope with Torazo. Unable to bear the sight of the pathetic Matsuhei, Kakubei devises a plan to win Oryo back, but...
t307039.tmdb_overview_en: Film about Sakamoto Ryōma. The focus is on Oryo, the maid who became Ryoma’s wife and lived with him for one year before his death.
t307039.tmdb_overview_jp: 竜馬が暗殺されて13年が過ぎた。新政府の役人・菅野覚兵衛は、師弟関係にあった坂本竜馬の十三回忌を催すため、竜馬の元妻である義理の姉おりょうを訪ねた。おりょうは西村松兵衛という冴えない男と電撃再婚し、ボロの長屋で貧乏生活を送っていた。しかし、実はこの時すでにおりょうには竜馬にそっくりの愛人・虎蔵がいた。おりょうは松兵衛と再婚したはいいが、貧乏と退屈な暮らしにすっかり愛想を尽かしてしまい、虎蔵と駆け落ちしようとしていたのだ。覚兵衛は、情けない松兵衛を見かねて、おりょうを取り戻す作戦を立てるのだったが…。

t255727.synopsis_en: Directed by Jun Ichikawa and based on Mariko Hayashi's short story "One Year Later," this is a love story limited to one year, starring Rena Tanaka and Kirin Kiki, who showed great chemistry in an Ajinomoto commercial. Eriko, who has just broken up with her boyfriend, changes jobs for a fresh start, but her tedious days remain much the same as before. One day, Eriko attends a group blind date with elite salarymen and becomes interested in a man named Tamura who exudes a mysterious atmosphere. A few days later, Tamura gladly accepts Eriko's invitation to a date, but during the date he confesses that he has a girlfriend studying abroad in America...
t255727.tmdb_overview_en: Eriko – lonely, aimless and self-absorbed – falls for Tamura. Despite knowing that he is waiting for his girlfriend to return from overseas, she requests to enter into a relationship with him for just one year.
t255727.tmdb_overview_jp: 味の素のCMで息の合ったところを見せた田中麗奈と樹木希林を主演に、林真理子の短編小説「一年ののち」を市川準が描いた、一年限りの恋物語。つきあっていた彼と別れたばかりのエリコは気分転換にと転職しては見たものの、その退屈な日々は以前とあまり変わらなかった。そんなある日、エリートサラリーマンとの合コンに出かけたエリコは不思議な雰囲気を漂わすタムラという男に興味を持つようになる。数日後、エリコからのデートの誘いに快く応じたタムラだったが、タムラはデートの最中にアメリカに留学中の恋人がいることを告白する……。

t307033.tmdb_overview_en: Living in an old Tokyo district, Kenichi works at a second-hand bookshop to support his sister, Yoko, a high school student. When Yoko graduates, she starts work at a photo shop. By the time, Kenichi's girlfriend has decided to marry someone else as she is tired of waiting for him. When Yoko starts dating Kenichi's best friend, Makoto , he is strangely resentful, but when Makoto is involved in a fatal accident, brother and sister resume their routine life.

t103663.synopsis: . カンヌ国際映画祭 主演男優賞受賞！ 力強い演技が観る者の魂を揺さぶる衝撃作 離婚と失業を乗り越え、幼稚園の教師という職に就いたルーカスは、ようやく穏やかな日常を取り戻した。しかしある日、親友の娘クララの作り話によって、彼は小児愛者の烙印を押されてしまう。幼いクララの証言を町の住人は信じて疑わず、ルーカスは全てを失い、小さな町で孤立してしまう...。 . マッツが演じるのはこんな役！ 小児愛者の汚名を着せられ、村八分にされる心優しい幼稚園の教師ルーカス 子どもの言葉を妄信する人々に糾弾され、身も心もボロボロになっていく…。 . .
t103663.synopsis_en:
Winner of the Best Actor Award at the Cannes Film Festival! A shocking masterpiece with a powerful performance that shakes the viewer's soul.

After overcoming divorce and unemployment to find work as a kindergarten teacher, Lucas has finally reclaimed a peaceful life. However, one day, a fabrication by his best friend’s daughter, Klara, brands him a pedophile. The townspeople believe the young girl’s testimony without question; Lucas loses everything and becomes isolated in the small town...

The role Mads plays:
Lucas, a kind-hearted kindergarten teacher who is falsely accused and ostracized by the community. Denounced by those who blindly believe a child’s words, he is left physically and mentally shattered...
t103663.tmdb_overview_jp: “北欧の至宝”と称される名優、マッツ・ミケルセンを主演に迎えたサスペンス・ドラマ。一人の少女の作り話によって、変質者の烙印を押されてしまった幼稚園教師のルーカス。全てを失った彼はさらなる迫害の標的となり……。

t3549.movie_title: アフター・ウェディング
t3549.movie_title_jp: アフター・ウェディング
t3549.clean_title_jp: アフター・ウェディング
t3549.synopsis: . アカデミー賞 外国語映画賞ノミネート ハリウッドリメイクもされた感動のヒューマンドラマ インドで孤児の援助活動を行うデンマーク人のヤコブは、祖国の実業家ヨルゲンから巨額の寄付金の申し出を受ける。故郷に戻ったヤコブはヨルゲンとの交渉を成立させるが、娘の結婚式に出席するよう誘われる。思いがけない人と再会した彼は、衝撃的な事実を知ることになる...。 . マッツが演じるのはこんな役！ インドで孤児院を経営する、秘密を抱えたナイーヴな理想主義者ヤコブ 子どもたちにも慕われる、母性本能をくすぐる優男だが実は隠された過去があり…。 . . .
t3549.synopsis_en:
Academy Award nominee for Best Foreign Language Film. An emotional human drama that inspired a Hollywood remake.

Jacob, a Danish man dedicated to helping orphans in India, receives an offer for a massive donation from Jørgen, a businessman back in his home country. Returning home, Jacob finalizes the deal with Jørgen, only to be invited to his daughter's wedding. There, an unexpected reunion leads him to a shocking discovery...

Mads plays this role:
Jacob, a naive idealist with a secret who runs an orphanage in India. Beloved by the children, he is a gentle soul who evokes a sense of tenderness, yet he harbors a hidden past...

t360114.movie_title_en: Shepherds' Journey into the Third Millennium
t360114.director: エリッヒ・ラングヤール
t360114.synopsis: スイスの羊飼い一家の日々の営みをアルプスの山々を背景に描く。何百頭もの羊の群れ。雪のなか牧草を求めてさまよい、車が行き交う道路を横断する。子羊の出産とそれを見つめる妻や子ども、乳搾りやパン作りの毎日。世界最古の職業のひとつであるといわれる羊飼いの、実際は過酷な労働でもある生活を見つめる。
t360114.synopsis_en: A portrait of the daily life of a Swiss shepherd family set against the backdrop of the Alps. A flock of hundreds of sheep. Wandering through snow in search of pasture, crossing roads busy with traffic. The birth of lambs and the wife and children watching over them, the daily routines of milking and bread-making. The film observes the life of shepherds—said to be one of the world's oldest professions—which is in reality also grueling labor.
t360114.tmdb_overview_en: Director Erich Langjahr follows several of the last remaining shepherds in Switzerland, on the cusp of the third millennium. How does one of the oldest human means of subsistence survive into the modern age? At an unhurried pace, he captures the shepherd, his sheep, his dogs and his mules as they trudge across snow-covered fields, climb mountain passes and cross highways. The sheep have to be cared for all year round and the life of a shepherd is physically demanding. Shepherds stay outdoors, or in small huts and caravans – often in places inaccessible by car. During their long periods away from home, their families expand and their children grow up. But they wouldn’t have it any other way; being a shepherd is a very conscious life choice. One of them puts it like this: “I just can’t sit still. As long as my health allows me I’ll always be on the go. No matter where in the world, I’d like to be on the go forever.”

t296313.synopsis: . あなたの“マッツ愛”が試される?! 狂気的な怪演が光る 奇想天外、クセ者たちのルーツ探しの狂想曲 大学教授のガブリエルと、女とトリビアにしか興味がないエリアスの兄弟は、父親の遺品からビデオレターを発見し、父がふたりの生物学的な父親ではないこと、それぞれの母親も違うことを知る。二人は父親の住所を探し出すが、辿り着いたのは、家畜が放し飼いにされ、3人の異母兄弟が暮らす寂れた屋敷だった...。 . マッツが演じるのはこんな役！ 無造作なクセ毛に無精ヒゲ、短気で暴力的、対人関係に難ありの偏屈な男エリアス 女好きで狂気的な役柄を怪演するも、その色気は隠しきれない…?! . .
t296313.synopsis_en: Will your "Mads love" be put to the test?! A wild, eccentric rhapsody of a roots-seeking journey among oddballs, featuring a crazed, standout performance. Gabriel, a university professor, and his brother Elias, who cares only about women and trivia, discover a video letter among their late father's belongings and learn that their father was not their biological parent and that each of them has a different mother. The two track down their father's address, but what they arrive at is a desolate mansion where livestock roam freely and three half-brothers live... Mads plays a role like this! Elias: a grumpy, difficult man with unkempt curly hair and stubble, short-tempered and violent, with trouble in interpersonal relationships. He gives a crazed, standout performance as a womanizing character, yet his allure cannot be hidden...?!
t296313.tmdb_overview_en: Men & Chicken is a black comedy about two outcast brothers who, by getting to know their unknown family, discover a horrible truth about themselves and their relatives.

t495152.synopsis_en: Shibuya, Tokyo. Yoichi and Michio are a pair of small-time thugs who make their living as illegal bookmakers for horse racing. One day, after a comrade of theirs causes an incident, Yoichi is urged by those around him to become a real yakuza. Yoichi wants to put an end to his petty-thug life, but at the same time he feels conflicted about being invited into the yakuza world while his big-brother figure Michio is left out. Around that time, the whereabouts of drugs Yoichi had been holding sets the gears of fate turning for Yoichi and Michio's lives as small-time thugs.
t495152.tmdb_overview_en: Shibuya, Tokyo. Yoichi and Michio are a pair of hoodlums who make their living as bookies at horse races. One day, Yoichi's companion commits a crime, which leads him to become a real yakuza. In this way Yoichi wishes to put an end to his hoodlum days, but on the other hand he has to leave his brother Michio behind...
t495152.tmdb_overview_jp: 東京・渋谷。競馬のノミ屋をなりわいとするチンピラコンビ、洋一と道夫。ある日、洋一は仲間がある事件を起こしたのをきっかけに、周囲から本物のヤクザになるよう勧められる。こうしてチンピラ業にけじめを付けたいと願った洋一だが、一方で兄貴分の道夫を差し置いてヤクザ業に誘われたことに対して複雑な心境を抱く。そのころ、洋一が預かっていたドラッグの行方をきっかけに、洋一と道夫のチンピラ人生の運命の歯車は狂いだす。

t1447567.movie_title: きっと青春大革命！ カルラ8年の記録
t1447567.movie_title_jp: きっと青春大革命！カルラ8年の記録
t1447567.clean_title_jp: きっと青春大革命！カルラ8年の記録
t1447567.synopsis_en: A documentary by transgender director Kani Lapuerta, recording eight years in the life of a transgender elementary school student in Mexico as she grows into a teenager. In Tepoztlán, a town south of Mexico City, 15-year-old Carla talks with director Kani Lapuerta in a secret cocoon. They discuss what kind of film they want to make, and begin to look back on Carla's life chronologically from her elementary school days. The schoolyard where she couldn't line up with either the 'boys' or 'girls,' the bedroom where she endlessly practiced makeup, the morning school reopened during the pandemic, the city hall where she officially changed her name, the slogans she shouted at the Pride March, and the baton club she admired. Watched over by her punk and hippie chef parents, her friends, director Lapuerta, the queer community, and the sacred rocky mountain, Carla encounters various versions of herself. Director Kani Lapuerta also appears in the film, gradually sharing her inner thoughts with Carla like an exchange diary. With comedic touches, it portrays the struggles and fluctuations of adolescence growing up in a small town with strong gender stereotypes.
t1447567.tmdb_overview_en: At the foot of Tepozteco, a sacred hill that governs the winds and fertility, lies the small town of Tepoztlán. Against this backdrop, fifteen-year-old Karla's body and mind are undergoing a revolution.
t1447567.tmdb_overview_jp: メキシコシティの南に位置する町テポストラン。15歳のカルラが、秘密のコクーンでカニ・ラプエルタ監督と会話している。ふたりはこの映画をどのような作品にしたいか話し合い、カルラの人生を小学生の頃から時系列に振り返りはじめる。「男子」と「女子」のどちらの列にも並べなかった校庭、永遠にメイクの練習をしていたベッドルーム、コロナ禍で学校が再開した朝、名前を正式に変更した市役所、プライドマーチで叫んだスローガン、憧れたバトン部。パンクでヒッピーだった料理人のママとパパや、友だち、ラプエルタ監督、そしてクィアコミュニティと聖なる岩山に見守られながら、カルラはさまざまな自分に出会っていく。

t88273.synopsis: . ベルリン国際映画祭 脚本賞＆男優賞W受賞 デンマーク王室最大のスキャンダルを描いた歴史劇 18世紀後半、王政末期のデンマーク。野心家のドイツ人ストルーエンセは、精神を病んだデンマーク国王クリスチャン7世の侍医に就く。王の唯一の理解者であり親友となる一方で、ストルーエンセは孤独な王妃カロリーネの心も虜にし、二人は禁断の恋に落ちていくのだった……。 . マッツが演じるのはこんな役！ 王宮の侍医の身分で王に取り入り、実権を握ったデンマーク史に残る野心家ストルーエンセ 色香漂うポニーテール＆コスチューム姿で、禁断の恋に落ちる男を熱演！ . .
t88273.synopsis_en: Winner of both the Silver Bear for Best Screenplay and Best Actor at the Berlin International Film Festival. A historical drama depicting the greatest scandal of the Danish royal family. In the late 18th century, Denmark at the end of the absolute monarchy. The ambitious German Struensee becomes the personal physician of the mentally ill Danish King Christian VII. While becoming the king's only confidant and best friend, Struensee also captivates the heart of the lonely Queen Caroline, and the two fall into a forbidden love... What kind of role does Mads play? Struensee, an ambitious figure in Danish history who, as the royal physician, ingratiates himself with the king and seizes real power. In a bewitching ponytail and costume, he passionately portrays a man who falls into forbidden love!
t88273.tmdb_overview_en: A young queen falls in love with her physician, and they start a revolution that changes their nation forever.

t1456349.synopsis: ある夜、ワヒドが働く工房に、野良犬と衝突事故を起こした家族連れの男が車の修理を求めてやってくる。その男が義足を引きずる奇妙な音を耳にした瞬間、ワヒドの脳裏に忌まわしい過去が蘇る。かつて政治犯として不当に投獄されたワヒドは、“義足”というあだ名で恐れられた看守エグバルから残忍な拷問を受け、人生の大切なものすべてを奪われてしまったのだ。ガレージに現れた義足の男こそはエグバルだと確信したワヒドは、翌日、強引に拉致した彼を荒野に生き埋めにしようとする。しかし、エグバルの顔を見たことがないワヒドの心に迷いが生じる。一旦報復を取りやめたワヒドは、同じトラウマを抱える元囚人たちのもとを訪ねるが、誰も義足の男がエグバル本人だとは証明できない。やがてワヒドらがもくろむ復讐殺人は、思いがけない事態へと迷走していくのだった……。
t1456349.synopsis_en: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.
t1456349.tmdb_overview_en: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.
t1456349.tmdb_overview_jp: かつて不当な理由で投獄されたワヒドは、ある偶然によって、自分の人生を奪った看守に出会う。咄嗟に男を拘束し、荒野に穴を掘り埋めようとするが、男は人違いだと言う。実はワヒドは、男の顔を見たことがなかった。男は、本当に復讐の相手なのか？一旦復讐を中断し、同じ男に拷問された友人を訪ねることにするが･･･。

t1263012.director: ガス・ヴァン・サント
t1263012.synopsis: 1977年、インディアナ州。不動産ローン会社に押し入ったトニー・キリシスは社長の息子ディックを人質に取って、“デッドマンズ・ワイヤー”という自動発砲装置を自分と人質の首に固定する。「すべてを奪われた」と訴え立てこもる彼の要求は、金銭的補償と“社長からの謝罪”だった。動くに動けない警察が事態の打開を図る一方、彼は人気ラジオ番組へ電話したりTVでの記者会見を要求したりと予測不能な行動に出て事態は混迷を極める。前代未聞の極限状態に世間は騒然、賛否が巻き起こる中、ついに社長と電話がつながるのだが――。
t1263012.synopsis_en: Tony Kiritsis (Bill Skarsgård), a middle-aged single man living in Indianapolis, believing he was swindled out of his entire life savings by the mortgage company Meridian Mortgage, breaks into their office and takes the president's son and executive, Dick Hall (Dacre Montgomery), hostage. Using a device called a "dead man's wire"—a shotgun and wire rigged to his and the hostage's necks so that any sudden movement would trigger the gun—he demands an apology and compensation from the company. With the local police completely unable to act, Tony calls a popular radio show to expose Meridian Mortgage's wrongdoing, involving the show's DJ Fred Temple (Coleman Domingo) to broadcast his claims. The mortgage company's representative issues a statement on TV accepting Tony's demands, but Tony refuses, insisting that the president, M.L. Hall, must apologize in person first. As the situation shows no sign of improvement, the FBI arrives and begins profiling Tony, while police prepare for a raid. Suspicion of a bomb on the scene brings in a bomb squad, tightening the net around Tony. Meanwhile, Tony's next move is to call in the three major US networks and other media to the scene, holding a press conference with the dead man's wire still pointed at Dick. Tony's appeal through the media divides public opinion and throws America into chaos.
t1263012.tmdb_overview_en: In 1977, former real estate developer Tony Kiritsis puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.

t531978.tmdb_overview_en: A young prosecutor named Takao falls in love with Yoriko, only to discover that her husband is the target of his investigation into a major corruption scandal. Torn between professional duty and their forbidden affair, the couple finds themselves trapped by societal expectations and legal consequences.

t1552998.tmdb_overview_en: Free access to the Gaza Strip has remained closed to international journalists since the war began on October 7, 2023. AFP's permanent reporters are among the few professional witnesses to have experienced this conflict from the inside. They have watched, filmed, photographed, testified, all whilst struggling to ensure their own survival.  From their exile, they recount this war, which is the deadliest ever recorded for members of the press.

t1184854.synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.
t1184854.tmdb_overview_en: Overcoming a mid life crisis, an unlikely character inadvertently creates one of the world's hardest ultramarathons. This intrepid adventure becomes a journey into humanity’s indomitable spirit.
t1184854.tmdb_overview_jp: 香港に存在する4大トレイル・コース（総距離298キロ、獲得標高14,500m）を制限時間以内に走り切らなければならない、という超過酷なイベント【香港フォー・トレイルズ・ウルトラ・チャレンジ】。  60時間以内にゴールした者には「FINISHER(完走者)」、72時間以内の者には「SURVIVOR（生還者）」の称号が与えられるそのレースに出走した18人のランナーたちの極限に挑む姿と、これまで見る機会がほとんどなかった香港の美しい大自然を余すところなく収めた感動のドキュメンタリー。  香港では2024年末、小規模で公開が始まり、瞬く間に口コミが拡がって上映館数が増え、大スター チョウ・ユンファも「すべての香港人が観るべき」と大絶賛。スポーツ愛好者のみならず一般映画ファンにも支持されて15万人を動員する2025年最大のサプライズ・ヒットとなりました。  香港に生まれ育った英国人監督ロビン・リーが2年以上を費やして編集。香港電影金像奨 新人監督賞を受賞、編集賞にもノミネート。観る者は、ランナーたちが繰り広げるドラマに胸を熱くし、やがては香港という街に息づく不屈のエネルギーをも感じることが出来るでしょう。

t1508322.synopsis_en: A humorous drama about the inheritance disputes that erupt within a once-close family after the death of their elderly mother. The Suzuki family mourns the loss of their mother, but soon, arguments break out over her estate: the eldest and second daughters insist on selling the family home and splitting the proceeds, the younger brother and his wife claim the land and house as their inheritance as the family successor, and the widow of the deceased eldest son joins the fray, souring their previously warm relationships. When a later-discovered will surfaces, objections arise, worsening the rifts. The conflict escalates to the point of litigation, but... Nene Otsuka plays the eldest daughter Reiko, Yami Yumiko plays the second daughter Satomi, and Shinobu Nakayama plays Sanae, the widow of the late eldest son. Akiko Matsumoto takes on the role of a consultant offering inheritance advice from a legal standpoint, while Yota Kawase plays Reiko's husband Seiichi. The film is directed and written by Fujimura Mamiya, known for scripting the 'Care Nin' series, which depicted the realities of nursing care.
t1508322.tmdb_overview_en: The Suzuki family faced the problem of inheritence division when their mother died. Different views on rights, obligations and affection for the mother have divided key family members. Will mother's love, filial piety and family ties heal the separation between them?

t1310165.synopsis: 日本で女優として長篇劇映画のプロダクションを初めて興した入江たか子の主演作で、入江ぷろと木村の協働が生んだ重要作。寒村から南方に出稼ぎにいった多くの女性のひとり、おゆき（入江）は、西欧人との間に生まれた子どもをつれて故郷に帰る。しかし、村の男たちは彼女を差別し、お金を搾取することしか考えていなかった。2人の苦難と、同じ境遇の女性たちとの連帯が、アイデアに満ちた鮮烈な演出で描かれる。
t1310165.synopsis_en: A starring vehicle for Takako Irie, who became the first woman in Japan to establish a production company for feature-length narrative films, this is an important work born from the collaboration between Irie Productions and Kimura. Oyuki (Irie), one of many women who left her impoverished village to work in the South Seas, returns home with a child born from a relationship with a Western man. However, the village men discriminate against her and think only of exploiting her money. The hardships of the two and their solidarity with women in the same situation are depicted through vivid, idea-rich direction.
t1310165.tmdb_overview_en: "Karayuki-san offers a no-holds-barred depiction of the discrimination faced by a former prostitute who returns to Japan from Singapore with her mixed-race son." - Alexander Jacoby (Oxford Brookes University)

n牧塲物語.synopsis: 中国戦線で軍医から故郷の牧場を託された3人は、閉鎖を企む高利貸しから牧場を守ろうと従業員一同と奮闘する。国家総動員法成立と同年の公開で、銃後の意識の啓発を企図して製作された。生産の場を働く者たちの共同体として捉え、資本の脅威に対抗するさまが、社会主義的とも評された『麦秋』（キング・ヴィダー、1934）も彷彿とさせ興味深い。本作でデビューの江波和子は、高利貸しの社長令嬢であるヒロインを演じている。
n牧塲物語.synopsis_en: Three men entrusted with their hometown ranch by an army doctor on the China front struggle alongside all the employees to protect the ranch from a moneylender plotting to shut it down. Released in the same year the National Mobilization Law was enacted, it was produced with the intent of raising home-front awareness. It is fascinating how the production site is conceived as a community of workers resisting the threat of capital, evoking King Vidor's Our Daily Bread (1934), which was also described as socialist. Kazuko Enami, making her debut in this film, plays the heroine, the daughter of the moneylender company's president.

n長崎の子うなぎとり.synopsis: 爆心地に近接していたことから甚大な被害を受けた長崎の城山小学校を舞台に、原爆で母親を失った3人の少年少女の友情を描く。現地の子どもたちを取材し、その生活風景から物語を着想する方法は、以後、木村の児童映画制作の根幹をなすこととなる。
n長崎の子うなぎとり.synopsis_en: Set at Shiroyama Elementary School in Nagasaki, which suffered devastating damage due to its proximity to the hypocenter, this film depicts the friendship of three boys and girls who lost their mothers to the atomic bomb. The method of interviewing local children and drawing inspiration for the story from scenes of their daily lives would thereafter form the foundation of Kimura's children's filmmaking.

t295357.synopsis: 村に赴任してきた教師の目を通じて、生活の基盤が海と山で異なる2つのグループに住民が分かれ、対立している地域で育つ子どもたちの成長をユーモラスに描く。小学生が主人公の教育映画だが、子どもたちから真に教育を受けるのは旧来の意識にとらわれていた大人たちである。ヴェネチア国際映画祭に出品され、高い評価を得た。
t295357.synopsis_en: Through the eyes of a teacher newly assigned to a village, this film humorously depicts the growth of children raised in a community divided into two opposing groups whose livelihoods are based on the sea and the mountains respectively. Though it is an educational film with elementary school children as protagonists, it is the adults trapped in old ways of thinking who truly receive an education from the children. It was submitted to the Venice International Film Festival and received high acclaim.
t295357.tmdb_overview_en: Focuses on the mutual antipathy of two groups of children in an Izu village.

t1659897.synopsis_en: A romantic comedy adventure about a popular author (Arima) who flees from the media and the photographer (Takahashi) who happens to rescue her. Sawamura is delightful as the female boss who leads a group of fishermen!

t1235212.synopsis_en: A romantic comedy about a young man and woman who lose their jobs when their company goes bankrupt and struggle to open a curry rice restaurant. The heroine, played by Ohzora, is charming with her boundless vitality, and Sawamura plays her mother.

t1560591.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t1560591.synopsis: かいせつ 魅惑的でどこに行っても人を惹きつけてしまう“お手伝いさん”をめぐって起こる騒動を軽やかに描いた大家族コメディ。沢村はヒロインの母役。
t1560591.synopsis_en: A lighthearted big-family comedy depicting the commotion caused by a captivating "housemaid" who attracts people wherever she goes. Sawamura plays the heroine's mother.
t1560591.tmdb_overview_en: A countryside woman working as a maid gets scouted for a model job.

t729442.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t729442.synopsis: かいせつ 戦中戦後の混乱を背景に、薄幸ながら情熱的に生きたひとりの娼婦と、彼女を慕う人々との交流を描いた感動篇。沢村は強烈な教育者役。
t729442.synopsis_en: A moving film set against the turmoil of wartime and postwar Japan, depicting the exchanges between a woman who lived passionately despite her unfortunate circumstances as a prostitute, and the people who adored her. Sawamura plays a fierce educator.
t729442.tmdb_overview_en: Ayako Wakao won the Blue Ribbon and the Kinema Jumpo for this film.

n千羽鶴.synopsis: 広島平和記念公園の「原爆の子の像」建立までの実話に着想を得た作品。原爆症を患い入院した小学6年生の貞子（菅井）。貞子と同級生たちは回復を願って鶴を折るが、やがて貞子は帰らぬ人に。中学に進学した子どもたちは貞子をモデルにした像を建てるべく活動を始める。実際に像の建設運動が進む最中に現地でロケーション撮影を敢行、ラストには除幕式の光景が映し出される。
n千羽鶴.synopsis_en: Inspired by the true story behind the erection of the "Children's Peace Monument" in Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park. Sadako (Sugai), a sixth-grader who falls ill with radiation sickness and is hospitalized, folds cranes with her classmates in hopes of recovery, but eventually Sadako passes away. The children, now in junior high, begin a campaign to build a statue modeled after Sadako. Location shooting was carried out on site while the actual statue construction movement was underway, and the final scene shows the unveiling ceremony.

n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.movie_title: 愛することと生きること／末っ子大将
n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.movie_title_jp: 愛することと生きること／末っ子大将
n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.synopsis: 1957年に売春防止法が施行されたが、依然として対策が必要であるとの認識から、一般の理解と協力をより深めるべく製作された啓蒙映画。若い坑夫の実（左右田）と東京に出てきたものの街娼に身を落としていたたか子（小沢）は、ドヤ街の一室で自殺を図ったところを間一髪で救われる。やがて、婦人相談員の峰岸（平松）や民生委員の協力を得ながら、たか子は新たな人生へと一歩ずつ前進する。
n愛することと生きること末っ子大将.synopsis_en: Produced as an educational film to deepen public understanding and cooperation, recognizing that measures were still needed even after the Anti-Prostitution Act took effect in 1957. A young miner named Minoru (Soda) and Takako (Ozawa), who came to Tokyo but fell into street prostitution, attempt suicide in a room in a flophouse district and are saved at the last moment. Eventually, with the help of a women's counselor named Minegishi (Hiramatsu) and a welfare commissioner, Takako takes one step at a time toward a new life.

n新中国を行くシリーズ.movie_title: 新中国を行くシリーズ
n新中国を行くシリーズ.movie_title_jp: 新中国を行くシリーズ
n新中国を行くシリーズ.synopsis: 1961年に日本テレビで放映されたドキュメンタリーシリーズ。木村は監修を務めた。1953年に中国から帰国した当時、木村は「人民のための中国が逞しく起ち上りつつある」（『キネマ旬報』1953年4月下旬号）と書き、後年には「いまの中国はこうなんだ、本当はこうなんだということを話すには帰る必要があると思って、帰ってきたんですよ」（『講座 日本映画2』岩波書店）とそのときの心境を語っている。本作撮影時の中国は大躍進政策による飢饉に見舞われていたが、完成した作品は、農業の集団化や工業化により、まさに「人民のための中国」が実現したことを喧伝する内容となっている。
n新中国を行くシリーズ.synopsis_en: A documentary series broadcast on Nippon Television in 1961. Kimura served as supervisor. When he returned from China in 1953, Kimura wrote that 'a China for the people is rising up vigorously' (Kinema Junpo, late April 1953 issue), and in later years spoke of his state of mind at the time: 'I thought I needed to go back to talk about what China is really like now, what it's truly like' (Koza Nihon Eiga 2, Iwanami Shoten). At the time of filming, China was suffering from famine caused by the Great Leap Forward policy, but the completed work propagates that 'a China for the people' had indeed been realized through agricultural collectivization and industrialization.

n都會の怪異7時03分.synopsis: ギャンブル好きだが心を入れ替えて人生をやり直そうとしている男が、ある日、怪しい老人から「明日の夕刊」を買ったことをきっかけにして起こる悲劇を描いたミステリー。谷譲次、林不忘などジャンルごとに異なったペンネームを持つマルチ作家・牧逸馬の怪奇小説を木村が都会的なタッチで映画化している。
n都會の怪異7時03分.synopsis_en: A mystery depicting the tragedy that unfolds after a man who loves gambling but is trying to reform his life one day buys a 'tomorrow's evening edition' from a suspicious old man. Kimura adapts a bizarre tale by Boku Issa—a versatile author who wrote under different pen names for different genres, including Joji Tani and Fumio Hayashi—with an urban touch.

t360453.synopsis: 室生犀星の同名小説を最初に映画化した作品。妊娠して家に戻ってきた妹と、愛するがゆえに妹を許せずつらく当たってしまう兄の愛憎を濃密に描く。多摩川沿いの労働者たちの生活を生々しいリアリズムで描き、傾向映画を彷彿とさせる。本作は、昭和11年のキネマ旬報ベスト・テンに同年の『彦六大いに笑ふ』とともに選出された。
t360453.synopsis_en: The first film adaptation of Murō Saisei's novel of the same name. It vividly depicts the love-hate relationship between a younger sister who returns home pregnant and her older brother, who, because he loves her, cannot forgive her and treats her harshly. With raw realism, it portrays the lives of laborers along the Tama River, evoking the tendency films of the era. This work was selected for the Kinema Junpo Best Ten of 1936, along with that year's "Hikoroku Laughs Heartily."
t360453.tmdb_overview_en: Ino tries to control Mon’s every move, but she becomes a fallen woman, having an affair with a student, Obata whereas her sister San remains a “good girl.” The mother is very supportive of her daughters, but, the father, Akaza, who is the stonecutter foreman on the damn, lacks control of his family.

t851973.synopsis: 再開発のため立ち退きを迫られ、ほとんど誰もいなくなった新宿の一角に佇む商業ビルで、抵抗し居座り続ける彦六（徳川）。家族や愛人、階下の住人たちそれぞれの思惑が交錯し、土地ブローカーのいやがらせで暴動へと発展するなか、行方知れずだった息子・彦一（丸山）が戻ってくるが…。明け方の開放感と、美術・久保一雄による見事な夜の室内セットとの対比も見どころ。後の『からゆきさん』へと結実していく、社会の周縁に生きる人々やその共同生活のあり方を見つめる視点は、本作においても印象的である。
t851973.synopsis_en: In a corner of Shinjuku nearly emptied of people due to redevelopment, Hikoroku (Tokugawa) stands firm and refuses to leave a commercial building slated for demolition. The agendas of his family, mistress, and the tenants downstairs all intersect, and when a land broker's harassment escalates into a riot, his missing son Hikoichi (Maruyama) returns—but... The contrast between the sense of liberation at dawn and the magnificent nighttime interior set by art director Kazuo Kubo is also a highlight. The perspective of observing people living on the margins of society and their communal way of life—which would later come to fruition in Karayuki-san—is equally striking in this work.

t1789771.synopsis: ふたたび木村が起用されたP.C.L.第2作は、ムーラン・ルージュ新宿座の舞台劇「恋愛都市東京」の映画化。モガ、モボたちが暮らすお茶の水界隈、丸の内の出版社、浅草のデパートなどを舞台に、親友だが対照的な性格の2人の女性の生き方が描かれる。開巻から洋画のようなタッチを狙っているのは明らかで、これが本格デビュー作となる竹久以外は前作とほぼ同じキャストによる音楽劇ながら、全体に陰のムードが立ち込め、木村演出の的確さが光る。
t1789771.synopsis_en: The second P.C.L. film to feature Kimura is an adaptation of the stage play "Love City Tokyo" from the Moulin Rouge Shinjuku-za. Set in the Ochanomizu neighborhood where modern girls and modern boys live, a publishing house in Marunouchi, and a department store in Asakusa, it depicts the lives of two women who are best friends but have contrasting personalities. It is clearly aiming for a Western-film-like touch from the opening, and while it is a musical drama with roughly the same cast as the previous film—except for Takehisa, for whom this is his full-fledged debut—a shadowy mood pervades the whole, and Kimura's precise direction shines.
t1789771.tmdb_overview_jp: 1933 年制作の木村荘十二監督作品

t36871.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t36871.synopsis: かいせつ かつて芸者仲間だった熟年の女たちの、それぞれの悲哀を描いた名篇。杉村、望月、沢村、細川、四人のベテラン女優が織り成す名演が胸を打つ。
t36871.synopsis_en: A celebrated film depicting the respective sorrows of middle-aged women who were once fellow geisha. The masterful performances woven together by four veteran actresses—Sugimura, Mochizuki, Sawamura, and Hosokawa—are deeply moving.
t36871.tmdb_overview_en: What is the life of a Geisha like once her beauty has faded and she has retired? Kin has saved, and become a wealthy money-lender, spending her days coldly collecting debts. Even her best friends, fellow Geisha Tomi, Nobu, and Tamae, are now indebted to her. For all of them, the glamour of their young lives has passed; Tomi and Tamae have disappointing children. Kin has two former lovers who still pursue her; one she wants to see, and the other she doesn't. But even the one she remembers fondly, when he shows up, proves less than satisfactory.

t256216.movie_title: 『女ばかりの夜』 ＊デジタル上映
t256216.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t256216.synopsis: かいせつ 売春防止法施行後、更生施設に収容された娼婦たちが新たな人生を切り開くため苦闘する姿を描いた社会派女性映画。沢村は施設の職員役。
t256216.synopsis_en: A socially conscious women's film depicting prostitutes who, after the enforcement of the Anti-Prostitution Law, are placed in rehabilitation facilities and struggle to carve out new lives for themselves. Sawamura plays a staff member at the facility.
t256216.tmdb_overview_en: In the wake of the 1956 Prostitution Prevention Law, a young woman recently released from one of Japan's new rehabilitation centers struggles to build a new life.
t256216.tmdb_overview_jp: 昭和三十三年、売春防止法が施行された。巧みに法の網の目を潜って春を売る女は、依然として後を断たなかった。しかし、警察のきびしい取締りで検挙された彼女たちは、強制的に厚生寮か補導院へ送られ、そこで一定の補導期間を終えて更生への途に踏み出すのだが、彼女たちを迎える社会は意外に冷たく、想像できない困難が待ち受けていた。白菊婦人寮もそうした施設の一つで、邦子、チエ子、亀寿、小雪ら三十三人の女が収容されていた。彼女たちは、野上、北村、岡田など数人の寮母の熱心な指導のもとで、規律ある毎日の生活を送っていた。模範生邦子は、職安の斡旋で食料品店に勤める身となった。が、ある日、米屋の洩らした一言から他の店員が彼女の過去を知り、主人の妻よしにそれを告げ口された。それからというものは、差別待遇、軽侮と敵意に満ちた態度に苦しめられる毎日が続いた。一夜、よしの留守中に主人の達吉を誘惑、日頃のよしへの仕返しに強いて過ちを犯した邦子は、あてもなく街に出た。以前の悪い血がふたたび騒ぎはじめた。刑事に捕えられた彼女は、寮母野上と警察の保護室で再会した。野上の世話で今度は精機会社の女工になった。食料品では前身を隠していたため苦い思いをさせられたので、この職場では前身を同僚に打ち明けた。ところが、意外にも女工たちの余りにも常軌を逸した私生活に、邦子は呆然となった。安い賃金で働かされている彼女たちは、性の欲求と衣類や化粧品を得るための一挙両得を狙って、街の若者たちにセックスを売っているのだった。しかも、真面目に生きようとする邦子は、彼女　をある男に提供しようと図った同僚きみ子に反抗したことから、倉庫の中で残酷なリンチを受けた。邦子はそれでも挫けることなく、志摩夫人のバラ園に仕事を見つけて、学生食堂に勤める同僚チエとお寺の離れを借りた。邦子は幸福だった。園芸技師の早川は彼女の前身を知りながらも、愛情をもって接してくれた。早川は邦子と結婚の約束をし、やがてその承諾を得るため、郷里の母の許へ向かった。一日千秋の思いで邦子は待ったが、早川の母から志摩夫人あてに、体を売っていた女と息子を結婚させるわけにはいかない、という手紙が届いた。幾日かの後、房総のある海辺で海女となってまめまめしく働く邦子の姿が見られた。

t895979.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t895979.synopsis: かいせつ 阪東妻三郎、三船敏郎、勝新太郎でも映画化された人情ものの名作で、本作東映版では三國が松五郎をエネルギッシュに演じた。沢村は宿屋の女将役。
t895979.synopsis_en: A masterpiece of human drama previously filmed with Bando Tsumasaburo, Mifune Toshiro, and Katsu Shintaro; in this Toei version, Mikuni energetically plays Matsugoro. Sawamura plays the proprietress of an inn.

t434484.movie_title_jp: おんなの渦と淵と流れ
t434484.clean_title_jp: おんなの渦と淵と流れ
t434484.movie_title_original: おんなの渦と淵と流れ
t434484.program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
t434484.synopsis: かいせつ 壊れゆく貞淑な人妻の悲劇を、実験的な映像を用いて描く、異色の官能ミステリー。沢村は、その演技の幅の広さを見せつける怪演ぶり！
t434484.synopsis_en: A unique erotic mystery that uses experimental imagery to depict the tragedy of a virtuous wife as she falls apart. Sawamura delivers a striking performance that showcases the breadth of her acting range!
t434484.tmdb_overview_en: During the war a university professor meets a girl and marries her. Very soon however, it is apparent that their needs are not matched. He would much rather be translating Shakespeare than attending to her, and she has a secret in her past - one that results in her sleeping with a great number of men.

showings.tmdb_overview_jp: 都会から離れた平穏な街に幼い息子と二人で暮らす小林典子は、社会から孤立している《ひきこもり》を支援する活動をしていた。繋がりを必要としている様々な葛藤を抱えた人々と一心に向き合う彼女の元には、他に行く宛の無い人や相談が集まってくる。ある時、いつものように依頼を受けた典子が任されたのは、長い間ひきこもったままの三浦雅彦という男だった。初めは一切の関係を拒んでいた雅彦も、典子の地道な働きかけにより徐々に周囲と言葉を交わし始める。このまま順調に外の世界へと繋げることができるはずだった。しかし、彼には決してひき出したくない過去があった...。

showings.synopsis: 「トワイライト・ウォリアーズ　決戦！九龍城砦」などのルイス・クーが主演を務め、香港社会にはびこる汚職犯罪に立ち向かう捜査官の壮絶な闘いを描いたサスペンスアクション「風暴」シリーズ全5作のうちの第4作。 汚職捜査機関・香港廉政公署（ICAC）は、服役中の富豪が刑務官に賄賂を渡し不正に手を染めているとの告発を受ける。捜査官ロクは証拠をつかむべく囚人になりすまして刑務所に潜入するが、そこにはかつてロクが逮捕した男も服役していた。 共演は「イップ・マン外伝　マスターZ」のケビン・チェン、「トワイライト・ウォリアーズ　決戦！九龍城砦」でもルイス・クーと共演するレイモンド・ラム、「コールド・ウォー　香港警察　二つの正義」のラム・カートン。監督は「風暴」シリーズ全作を手がけるデビッド・ラム。2026年11月、「風暴」シリーズ全5作品を一挙上映する特集上映「風暴全史」にて劇場上映。

世界的な長寿地域「ブルーゾーン」の一つである沖縄に惹かれ、充実した人生の意味を求めていたスウェーデン人女性。 彼女はそこで、消えゆく精神的な風景と向き合うことになる。 座礁したイルカや失われゆく島の文化との出会いを通じて、自然、記憶、そして生存に対する人類の脆い関係性について、深く思いを巡らせることになるのだった。
世界有数の長寿地域「ブルーゾーン」として知られる沖縄の謎に惹かれ、ニコリーナ・スヴェンセンは、特別な生き方の秘密を探し求めてスウェーデンから旅立つ。 しかし彼女が島で目にしたのは、理想郷のイメージの奥で、静かに姿を変えつつある世界だった。 近代化の波が土地を変えていく中で、古くから受け継がれてきた食文化や祈り、繊細な手仕事は、少しずつ日常の中から消えつつある。 世代を超えて守られてきた生き方が静かに薄れていく姿を前に、ニコは、自分をこの地へ導いた問いそのものを見失い始める。 ——「本当に豊かに生きるとは、どういうことなのだろうか」。 そんな戸惑いの中、彼女は海岸に打ち上げられた一頭のイルカと出会う。 声なきその命に寄り添い、海へ還そうとする時間は、彼女に「生きること」の重みと、自然への深い畏敬を静かに教えていく。 その瞬間、ニコの内に芽生えたのは、本から得た知識ではなく、生々しく脈打つ「生」そのものの 感覚だった。 島を包む光、風、そして海は、ゆっくりと彼女の内面へと入り込んでいく。 「大いなるもの」に抱かれるようにして、ニコは、自分が探し求めていた答えが、遠い過去 の伝説の中にあるのではなく、人々のぬくもりや、自然と共に生きる営みの中に今も息づいていることに気づき始める。 これは、世界から少しずつ失われていく美しさを慈しみながら、その中で誠実に生きる道を探し続ける、ひとりの女性の祈りと再生の物語である。
